name: Hasan Mert Demirsoy
title: Game Master
goals: Tell the story of A Song of Fire and Blood
Keep the world moving regardless of the players
Make choices and consequences matter
Punish inadequate preparation when deserved
summary: Hasan Mert Demirsoy, better known as HMD, HRRM or H.R.R. Martin, is the Game Master and narrator behind A Song of Fire and Blood. He builds the world, directs its events and gives life to nearly every character beyond Jace, Gaelor and Visenor. Across years of roleplay he has run stories in countless settings and genres, developing a reputation as an exacting storyteller who remembers player choices, missed opportunities and inadequate preparation — and is rarely inclined to let any of them pass without consequence.

name: Aldren
title: The Great Game Mascot
goals: Welcome every player as an honored guest
Deliver the realm's notices with suitable ceremony
Preserve the player's dignity under all circumstances

mara-tapster.overview: His younger fellow mascot and practical counterweight.
mara-tapster.latestDevelopment: Where Aldren dresses every notice in ceremony, Mara strips it down to what the player actually needs to know.

summary: Aldren is the courtly innkeeper mascot of The Great Game and one of the two voices behind the site's notifications. After decades spent attending nobles, knights, merchants and wealthy travelers, he addresses every player as though a king or queen has just entered his establishment. His notices are warm, ceremonious and absurdly deferential, turning even ordinary activity into a matter worthy of Your Grace's attention.

name: Mara
title: The Great Game Mascot
goals: Keep The Great Game's patrons informed
Deliver notices without unnecessary ceremony
Keep the tavern running despite its patrons' nonsense

aldren-innkeeper.overview: Her older fellow mascot and ceremonial opposite.
aldren-innkeeper.latestDevelopment: Aldren assumes every player is the most important person in the room; Mara has served enough nobles and drunks to know better.

summary: Mara is the stoic tapster mascot of The Great Game and one of the two voices behind the site's notifications. Young, capable and thoroughly unimpressed, she has served enough nobles, sellswords, gamblers and loud drunks to recognize nonsense on sight. Her notices are concise, practical and dryly observant: she says what happened, adds only what is useful and leaves the ceremony to Aldren.

summary: Alysanne Hightower appeared only briefly, a silhouette in a high window watching Prince Gaelor's vanguard arrive at her family's gates. She and her sister were pinned to the floor as the Great Hall dissolved into violence, and in the blind panic that followed, a soldier's blade found her. Her death, unintended and unremarked upon by the men who caused it, is one of Oldtown's quietest tragedies.

summary: Decades ago, before Jaehaerys I died and succession became immediate, Baelor Targaryen chose a quieter life of study at the Citadel. He was therefore not a claimant when his younger brother Aenys II inherited the Iron Throne. Known as 'the argumentative one' of his generation — a title the King now pointedly applies to his own son Jacaelon — Baelor was recalled to King's Landing amid the Tyrell-Hightower treason crisis. He arrived too late to stop Gaelor's bloody campaign in the Reach and rode for the Red Keep in open alarm. Named Grand Maester in Cordin's place, he has since thrown himself into the Vahaemon problem with characteristic thoroughness: engineering Vahaemon's expulsion from Braavos through economic pressure, and planning to repeat the tactic in Pentos before funneling his exiled nephew toward Tyrosh where the Crown can end the succession threat with dragonfire rather than diplomacy. Melessa Hightower invites him back to the Citadel in a conciliatory letter whose true guiding hand he questions. He considers returning, but agrees with Jace that the realm must first be settled. He explains the uncertain nature of dragon dreams and describes Ghost, an ancient white and pale-blue she-dragon recorded in flooded caverns west of Volantis and later near Myr. He believes her long dead, allows that she may have laid eggs, and treats estimates of her size as uncertain. Jace asks him to investigate quietly in connection with Visenya.

rickard-stark.latestDevelopment: His elder son and heir, who inherited Winterfell and its burdens upon his death.

summary: Lord Brandon Stark inherited Winterfell and the wardenship of the North from his father, Edwyle Stark, in 87 AC. Unlike Edwyle, whose service to King Aenys earned lasting royal regard, Brandon never inspired much personal affection in King Baelenys. He nevertheless maintained the old relationship between Winterfell and the Crown until his quiet death in his own bed while the royal court drank and feasted at Driftmark on the Thirtieth Day of the Second Moon, 99 AC. Baelenys openly acknowledged that he had never cared much for Brandon, but the debt owed to Edwyle still mattered; he therefore sent Princess Saera north to formally offer the Crown's condolences. Brandon's death passed Winterfell and the wardenship to his elder son Rickard.

summary: Maester Cordin Poole has responded to his demotion not by retreating, but by attaching himself more closely to Prince Gaelor. In a secret meeting he reminded Gaelor that he had helped raise him, gently encouraged the assumption that Visenor may be dead, and offered a private surveillance network capable of following Jace and his entire inner circle. He also agreed to pursue the possibility that Ser Alester Dayne was involved in Curtass Whent's death and advised Gaelor to ask the King for command of the City Watch. Gaelor promised him full protection. Beneath Cordin's familiar fawning now sits a far more consequential ambition: to become indispensable to the prince he expects may one day wear the crown.

title: Former Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard

saathos-maris.latestDevelopment: The knight's investigation confirmed the broad shape of the ambush and the presence of a surviving blond knight, but never established with certainty who killed Whent.

summary: Once a Kingsguard whose exploits were sung about before most knights would dare dream of it, Curtass Whent left the order under circumstances the realm no longer discusses openly. King Baelenys called him back for one purpose: find Visenor. He very nearly succeeded, cornering Ser Alester Dayne with five sellswords in the woods south of King's Landing. The fight cost him his life at the hooves of his own target's horse — killed not by a sword, but by a desperate, dying act of improvisation from the man he had just beaten half to death. His body was found alongside those of his five sellswords near a rural sept, and word of his death reached the King, who received it with cold indifference.

summary: The quiet Lord of Torrentine, Darren Dayne has stayed carefully out of King's Landing's politics for most of his life, content to let his daughter Lorenah manage House Dayne's more delicate affairs. Neither he nor his seat ever expected to become entangled in sheltering a fugitive Crown Prince, but that is precisely what his family's choices have made of them. Nymos reports on the fourteenth day of the eighth moon that Darren left Starfall for Sunspear four days earlier; the purpose of the visit is not revealed.

baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Old friend and, until his fall, the King's most trusted Hand — a friendship of thirty years he betrayed for a cause he sincerely believed was greater than both of them.

gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Gaelor helped build the false-prisoner trap and spent a night disguised as a gaoler waiting for Derrin to appear; Derrin never came, but suspicion only deepened.

grance-morrigen.overview: Rode with him in Prince Baelenys's party during the Ashenmist Valley incident of 56 AC; Derrin urged Grance to keep pace as they hurried after the prince.
grance-morrigen.latestDevelopment: Rode with him in Prince Baelenys's party during the Ashenmist Valley incident of 56 AC; Derrin urged Grance to keep pace as they hurried after the prince.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: The prince who exposed his treason, led him into a locked room at Driftmark under false pretenses, extracted his full confession — including the name of the Lord of Highgarden — and executed him on the spot before disposing of the body at sea.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The prince who exposed his treason, led him into a locked room at Driftmark under false pretenses, extracted his full confession — including the name of the Lord of Highgarden — and executed him on the spot before disposing of the body at sea.

melessa-hightower.overview: His surviving daughter, whose life was spared only by chance in the Oldtown massacre.
melessa-hightower.latestDevelopment: His surviving daughter, whose life was spared only by chance in the Oldtown massacre.

myles-mooton.overview: Rode with him in Prince Baelenys's party during the Ashenmist Valley incident of 56 AC.
myles-mooton.latestDevelopment: Rode with him in Prince Baelenys's party during the Ashenmist Valley incident of 56 AC.

lorent-tyrell.overview: His co-conspirator; Lorent first approached him with the plan to poison the King, sharing his belief that the realm could not survive another of Baelenys's wars.
lorent-tyrell.latestDevelopment: His co-conspirator; Lorent first approached him with the plan to poison the King, sharing his belief that the realm could not survive another of Baelenys's wars.

timos-hightower.overview: His son, condemned and killed for a treason he never had any part in.
timos-hightower.latestDevelopment: His son, condemned and killed for a treason he never had any part in.

summary: For decades Derrin Hightower served as Baelenys' Hand and closest political adviser. After the poisoning attempt, he became the center of suspicion when the dying assassin allegedly whispered only two words: 'the Hand.' Confronted alone by Jacaelon at Driftmark, Derrin confessed everything: he had conspired with the Lord of Highgarden to poison the King, believing the realm could no longer survive Baelenys' wars and taxes, and that he acted for House Targaryen's future rather than against it. Jace executed him on the spot and disposed of his body at sea. To the realm, Derrin Hightower remains simply missing — his true fate known only to the King, his new Hand, and the sea.

name: Gaelor Targaryen
title: Prince Gaelor of House Targaryen
goals: Prove himself worthy of Blackfyre and the throne
Keep Maela's secret buried permanently
Counter Jace before he can undermine Gaelor's future reign
Use Cordin's men to watch Jace and his inner circle
Investigate whether Alester Dayne killed Curtass Whent
Return to Driftmark after the trial
Secure Braavosi support and take the Stepstones for House Targaryen

alester-dayne.overview: Now suspects Alester may be the large blond knight connected to Curtass Whent's death.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Gaelor fed Cordin a false claim that a Red Keep headcount left only Alester unaccounted for and ordered the matter investigated.

alysanne-hightower.overview: He never knew Alysanne personally, but his campaign against Oldtown brought her life to an end.
alysanne-hightower.latestDevelopment: She watched his forces arrive from the Hightower and was killed in the chaos that followed Timos's execution.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: After the Mummers' Blood, Baelenys sent him to Driftmark. Gaelor returns for Brant Costayne's trial and wins.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His father acknowledges the victory as the gods' judgment but warns that aggression alone cannot make a good prince, permits him one night in the Red Keep and expects him to stay away from the capital afterward.

baelor-targaryen.overview: Greeted his great-uncle warmly on the road back from Oldtown, before Baelor's visible horror at the massacre made clear how badly the campaign had been received.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Greeted his great-uncle warmly on the road back from Oldtown, before Baelor's visible horror at the massacre made clear how badly the campaign had been received.

baran-strong.overview: He saw in Baran a large, capable knight wasting away on Dragonstone and offered him a path back toward the Red Keep.
baran-strong.latestDevelopment: The invitation began as curiosity and usefulness more than trust, but Gaelor was willing to put his name behind it.

berholt-caswell.overview: He expected the Faith to answer Oldtown's blood more decisively and never received the condemnation he might have wanted.
berholt-caswell.latestDevelopment: Berholt refused to excommunicate him, partly from uncertainty over whether such a gesture would serve the gods or merely inflame the realm.

brannyn-vance.overview: Found him in Maela's bed, dragged him to the black cells, and killed him with Blackfyre in a humiliating, methodical execution that no one else witnessed.
brannyn-vance.latestDevelopment: Found him in Maela's bed, dragged him to the black cells, and killed him with Blackfyre in a humiliating, methodical execution that no one else witnessed.

brant-costayne.overview: Brant's attempt to avenge Oldtown ended in trial by combat on the Twentieth Day of the Eighth Moon.
brant-costayne.latestDevelopment: Brant badly cut Gaelor's left forearm, but Gaelor split his face with a sword strike and then beheaded him before the royal seats.

cordin-poole.overview: Cordin meets him immediately after his return from Driftmark, warns that Jace has drawn closer to Baelenys in his absence and encourages him to use the trial to rebuild his standing.
cordin-poole.latestDevelopment: Gaelor confides his plan to go to Essos and take the Stepstones.

curtass-whent.overview: He did not know Whent well enough to mourn him, but the old Kingsguard's death became a mystery Gaelor chose to pursue.
curtass-whent.latestDevelopment: The surviving report of a large blond knight fed his suspicion of Alester and gave Cordin another investigation to conduct.

daria-sand.overview: Unknown to him, Lorenah Dayne's maid Daria has learned of his alliance with Cordin and his move to take command of the City Watch, and reported both to Lorenah.
daria-sand.latestDevelopment: Unknown to him, Lorenah Dayne's maid Daria has learned of his alliance with Cordin and his move to take command of the City Watch, and reported both to Lorenah.

derrin-hightower.overview: He suspected Derrin before the proof was complete and helped build the false-prisoner trap meant to catch the Hand acting against the supposed poisoner.
derrin-hightower.latestDevelopment: Gaelor's failed night watch produced no confession, but the doubt it fed helped prepare Derrin's eventual fall.

godfrey-blackwood.overview: Tackled Costayne in the tourney lists when the knight's assassination attempt threatened to end Gaelor's life; Gaelor owes him a debt he has not yet named.
godfrey-blackwood.latestDevelopment: Tackled Costayne in the tourney lists when the knight's assassination attempt threatened to end Gaelor's life; Gaelor owes him a debt he has not yet named.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Their rivalry remains openly poisonous.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Jace mocks him as the banished prince on his return, while Cordin warns Gaelor that Jace has grown closer to the King during his absence.

jaery-targaryen.overview: His mother, who loves him fiercely but repeatedly reminds him that being heir demands more discipline than he naturally possesses.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His mother, who loves him fiercely but repeatedly reminds him that being heir demands more discipline than he naturally possesses.

lorenah-dayne.overview: He now treats Lorenah as part of Jace's political power rather than merely a Dornish guest.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: Naella warned that Jace's intended wife could become a second coordinated threat, and Gaelor accepted the logic of watching her along with the rest of his brother's inner circle.

maela-targaryen.overview: Discovered her in flagrant violation of her Kingsguard's vows and handled the aftermath himself — brutally and permanently — without ever telling her what he did to Vance.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The secret sits between them like a drawn sword.

malaenar-targaryen.overview: He knows Malaenar as the steady uncle who has remained on Dragonstone while the rest of the dynasty tears itself apart.
malaenar-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Their contact at the nameday reunion pulled Gaelor directly into the older generation's wounds over succession, exile, and Baelenys's past.

merryn-whitespring.overview: One of the renowned Motley Three whose royal satire Gaelor interrupted in Flea Bottom.
merryn-whitespring.latestDevelopment: Gaelor killed Merryn with Blackfyre on the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC.

mydan-gerren.overview: The sole surviving member of the Motley Three after Gaelor's attack.
mydan-gerren.latestDevelopment: Gaelor's soldiers took Mydan prisoner and began transporting him to the Red Keep.

naella-velaryon.overview: His wife and closest private confidante.
naella-velaryon.latestDevelopment: Naella has become increasingly protective of his political future, warning that Jace and Lorenah together may become a coordinated threat and urging Gaelor to place them under surveillance.

renrose-tyrell.overview: He regards Renrose as the head of a house that will never forgive Oldtown and may strike at the Crown again if given room.
renrose-tyrell.latestDevelopment: Gaelor does not know the full extent of Renrose's private support for Visenor, but already considers Highgarden a succession threat.

saathos-maris.overview: His companion during the Watch inspections and a drunken night in Flea Bottom.
saathos-maris.latestDevelopment: At Gaelor's order Saathos gathers gold cloaks to surround the mummers' tent; during the ensuing crush he uses his shield and sword flat rather than its edge.

saera-targaryen.overview: Rarely in open conflict, but her disgust after the Oldtown Massacre was plain; she called him a deranged psychopath before the King.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Rarely in open conflict, but her disgust after the Oldtown Massacre was plain; she called him a deranged psychopath before the King.

tansy-riverside.overview: He noticed Tansy more than once during the Dragonstone feast and understood the invitation in her attention.
tansy-riverside.latestDevelopment: Gaelor deliberately stepped away before flirtation could become another scandal.

timos-hightower.overview: Executed him personally at Oldtown to enforce the King's justice — a killing that spiraled into a massacre he did not fully intend and cannot entirely escape.
timos-hightower.latestDevelopment: Executed him personally at Oldtown to enforce the King's justice — a killing that spiraled into a massacre he did not fully intend and cannot entirely escape.

tion-lannister.overview: He has little patience for Tion's caution and treasury-minded objections.
tion-lannister.latestDevelopment: Their council exchanges regularly reduce to Tion calling Gaelor reckless and Gaelor dismissing him as timid.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: The little princess he has promised will always be his most loved, however many nieces and nephews may follow; she, in turn, defends him against everyone in the family who calls him a monster.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The little princess he has promised will always be his most loved, however many nieces and nephews may follow; she, in turn, defends him against everyone in the family who calls him a monster.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Frustrated by what he sees as weakness, though it was Gaelor who beat the poisoner's confession out of the dying assassin himself.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Frustrated by what he sees as weakness, though it was Gaelor who beat the poisoner's confession out of the dying assassin himself.

oswald-eagle.overview: The veteran commander remains in office after Gaelor loses the promised appointment.
oswald-eagle.latestDevelopment: Oswald surrenders the men involved in Gaelor's bloodshed for judgment.

zekar-alasyr.overview: One of the renowned Motley Three whose royal satire Gaelor interrupted in Flea Bottom.
zekar-alasyr.latestDevelopment: Gaelor killed Zekar with Blackfyre on the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC.

summary: Gaelor returns from Driftmark to King's Landing on the Twentieth Day of the Eighth Moon to answer Brant Costayne's trial by combat. The capital greets him with jeers and thrown food, but he defeats Brant before the Crown after suffering a deep wound to his left forearm, then beheads him and presents the victory as the gods' judgment. Baelenys permits him to remain one night but keeps him away from the capital. Gaelor now intends to return to Driftmark and then cross to Essos, hoping to take the Stepstones with Braavosi support and restore the honor he believes an heir should command.

name: Jacaelon Targaryen
title: Prince Jacaelon of House Targaryen, Hand of the King
goals: Earn Baelenys' respect
Protect House Targaryen, whatever the cost
Consolidate his power as Hand of the King
Build a powerful spy network
Identify what Visenya is doing in King's Landing and whose orders she follows
Marry Lorenah Dayne and protect the future they have chosen together
Travel to Dorne after the proposal
Keep Gaelor from turning their rivalry into open civil conflict
Carry Aegon's dream in secret and prepare the realm for the prince that was promised
Prove worthy of being named Baelenys' heir
Learn whether Vhaemys is a Dreamer and identify the great white dragon in her visions
Help Mydan Gerren and Flea Bottom recover from the Mummers' Blood
Investigate Rhaella and Nymos disappearing near Starfall without revealing the Crown’s private interest
Travel to Starfall with Lorenah once the immediate court business is settled
Understand the scale of Vahaemon’s dragon network and the blood-magic threat in Essos

alester-dayne.overview: Jace provokes him into a rough spar after noticing his misery, then learns Alester believes Saera loves Rickard Stark and has promised him a future.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Jace calls him an idiot for never speaking plainly and promises to talk to Saera himself.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Baelenys entrusts Jace with Aegon's dream, tells him Gaelor will not sit the Iron Throne and intends to name Jace heir once the present troubles are settled.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Jace accepts the burden and promises to make him proud.

baelor-targaryen.overview: Embraced him warmly on arrival and considers him the one voice at council that matches his own measured counsel.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Embraced him warmly on arrival and considers him the one voice at council that matches his own measured counsel.

baran-strong.overview: He received Baran respectfully as a capable knight but made clear that Gaelor could not unilaterally decide appointments around the Red Keep.
baran-strong.latestDevelopment: Jace sees room for Baran in royal service, though on the Hand's terms rather than his brother's whim.

berholt-caswell.overview: Negotiates Berholt's public support after the massacre, rejects bargaining over Gaelor's excommunication, and accepts Crown assistance for the sept's works.
berholt-caswell.latestDevelopment: Entrusts him with rites for the dead without princes or gold cloaks crowding the ceremony.

brant-costayne.overview: Offers to seek a new route out of the black cells while Gaelor's absence delays the trial by combat.
brant-costayne.latestDevelopment: Jace respects Brant's refusal to abandon the judgment he demanded and promises to find a date as soon as possible.

cordin-poole.overview: Lorenah has told him of Cordin's surveillance for Gaelor.
cordin-poole.latestDevelopment: At the council he challenges Cordin's closeness to his brother, takes responsibility for the surviving actor and dismisses Cordin from subsequent business.

daria-sand.latestDevelopment: After finding her in their chambers, Jace quietly instructed Daria to watch Vhaemys and ensure that the princess attended her lessons.

derrin-hightower.overview: Exposed his treason, extracted his confession in private, and executed him himself.
derrin-hightower.latestDevelopment: Only the King knows the truth.

edmyn-uller.overview: The Dornish maester at the scholars' retreat whose frankness about events in the realm — delivered by raven — proved unexpectedly useful.
edmyn-uller.latestDevelopment: The Dornish maester at the scholars' retreat whose frankness about events in the realm — delivered by raven — proved unexpectedly useful.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Their rivalry came to a bloody climax in the tourney lists; they have spoken to each other from infirmary beds since, and the King has commanded them to make peace.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Their rivalry came to a bloody climax in the tourney lists; they have spoken to each other from infirmary beds since, and the King has commanded them to make peace.

godfrey-blackwood.overview: Met him in the tourney lists and unhorsed him in a hard-fought six-pass tilt; Blackwood congratulated him graciously in the dirt.
godfrey-blackwood.latestDevelopment: Met him in the tourney lists and unhorsed him in a hard-fought six-pass tilt; Blackwood congratulated him graciously in the dirt.

jaery-targaryen.overview: His mother, one of the few people in the family to tell him plainly that she is proud of him.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: She personally pinned the Hand's badge to his chest.

lorenah-dayne.overview: No longer merely a courtship. In the secluded Cloudpass valley Jace proposed with a necklace crafted from Cloudgazer's shed horn-scales, and Lorenah accepted, saying the honor was not becoming a princess but spending her life beside him. They are now betrothed.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: Before the Chapter XVII council, Lorenah passes on Daria's discovery that Cordin is watching Jace for Gaelor.

lucas-corbray.overview: Jace catches Lucas protecting Vhaemys from the consequences of her kitchen punishment and reminds him that a Kingsguard oath cannot be bent simply because the princess is his friend.
lucas-corbray.latestDevelopment: Jace catches Lucas protecting Vhaemys from the consequences of her kitchen punishment and reminds him that a Kingsguard oath cannot be bent simply because the princess is his friend.

maela-targaryen.overview: His twin and emotional anchor; the person he is most protective of and least honest with.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His twin and emotional anchor; the person he is most protective of and least honest with.

naella-velaryon.overview: He knows her chiefly as Gaelor's wife and political confidante, but he does not yet realize how dangerous she considers him.
naella-velaryon.latestDevelopment: Naella has urged Gaelor to treat Jace and his inner circle as a future threat worth watching.

orwell-morrigen.overview: Trained under him rigorously during Alester's absence; Morrigen assessed him ready for knighthood, though it was Alester who ultimately performed the ceremony.
orwell-morrigen.latestDevelopment: Trained under him rigorously during Alester's absence; Morrigen assessed him ready for knighthood, though it was Alester who ultimately performed the ceremony.

perric-bracken.overview: He has tried to force the Blackwood-Bracken grievance into a form the Crown can contain, including an envoy and a proposed trial by combat.
perric-bracken.latestDevelopment: Perric's refusal to answer has left Jace with an unresolved feud that could still become a wider Riverlands problem.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: A raven reaches him saying Rhaella has failed to return for a full day and that burned bodies were found near Starfall beside a basket matching hers.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Jace does not know she is dead and begins a covert investigation before travelling south.

saathos-maris.overview: He has repeatedly encountered Saathos through Gaelor's orbit and finally faced him directly in the tourney lists.
saathos-maris.latestDevelopment: Saathos shattered Jace's shield and tore open his hand; Jace answered by breaking the knight's arm, unhorsing him, and immediately checking whether he would live.

saera-targaryen.overview: One of the siblings he trusts most.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Saera helped arrange and quietly supervise his proposal to Lorenah in the Cloudpass valley, then departed for Winterfell with Alester at Jace's urging.

steffon-baratheon.overview: Humiliated him publicly before the court when the young lord came demanding debt repayment from the Crown; unhorsed him in the tourney lists and the insult still burns on both sides.
steffon-baratheon.latestDevelopment: Humiliated him publicly before the court when the young lord came demanding debt repayment from the Crown; unhorsed him in the tourney lists and the insult still burns on both sides.

tion-lannister.overview: He has found an uneasy economic ally in Tion.
tion-lannister.latestDevelopment: Their temperaments differ, but both argued in council that spectacle and bloodshed are poor substitutes for policy, and Jace often values the Master of Coin's practicality even when they disagree.

vahaemon-targaryen.overview: He treats his exiled uncle as one of the central strategic problems of his Handship.
vahaemon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Jace is helping design the Crown's pressure campaign to drive Vahaemon through the Free Cities toward Tyrosh, while Visenya's return has made the family threat painfully personal.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: After Vhaemys dreams of Visenor crying out amid fire, Jace begins recording her visions and suspects she is a Dreamer.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He promises to keep the Dragonet close while investigating the enormous white dragon she repeatedly sees herself riding.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Once looked down on him and considered him weak; risking everything to save him and Rhaella changed that completely.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Once looked down on him and considered him weak; risking everything to save him and Rhaella changed that completely.

visenya-targaryen.overview: His cousin, Vahaemon's daughter — who climbed into his bed in a Flea Bottom brothel believing him to be Gaelor, held Dark Sister to his throat throughout, and vanished before he or Alester could catch her.
visenya-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The encounter left a cut on his neck and a great deal of unanswered questions.

weylar-rocke.overview: Jace summons Weylar after learning Rhaella may have been seen in Dorne, tells him to investigate Starfall through his own contacts and makes clear that the assignment must remain secret under threat of the black cells.
weylar-rocke.latestDevelopment: Jace summons Weylar after learning Rhaella may have been seen in Dorne, tells him to investigate Starfall through his own contacts and makes clear that the assignment must remain secret under threat of the black cells.

oswald-eagle.overview: Recognizes that Oswald neither attended nor ordered the massacre.
oswald-eagle.latestDevelopment: Thanks him for surrendering the implicated gold cloaks and asks him to stay in command without answering public anger with force.

mydan-gerren.overview: Visits the last surviving member of the Motley Three in the black cells, hears his account of the massacre, apologizes for the Crown's failure and promises protection and help rebuilding if Mydan ever returns to the stage.
mydan-gerren.latestDevelopment: Visits the last surviving member of the Motley Three in the black cells, hears his account of the massacre, apologizes for the Crown's failure and promises protection and help rebuilding if Mydan ever returns to the stage.

nymos.overview: The supposedly acting maester at Starfall disappears at the same time as Rhaella.
nymos.latestDevelopment: Lorenah has never heard of him, so Jace treats Nymos as a major lead in whatever happened near Starfall.

summary: Baelenys publicly treats Jace as the man expected to inherit and orders him to kill Visenya and Naela in Essos. Jace begins assembling a company around Orwell, Alester and Denlon, asks that Saathos be recalled for the dishonorable work ahead, and leaves Gaelor's participation undecided. He delays the planned journey to Dorne while awaiting news, then joins Saera and Vhaemys on Cloudgazer above King's Landing. There they physically encounter an enormous unidentified white dragon that focuses upon Vhaemys; Jace and Saera think of Meraxes, but neither the identity nor a bond is confirmed.

name: Jaery Targaryen
title: Queen of the Seven Kingdoms
goals: Keep the royal family together
Prevent Baelenys from destroying the family from within
Secure strong marriages for her remaining children
Find out what happened to Visenor

alester-dayne.overview: Entrusted Saera directly to his protection for the Winterfell journey.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Jaery reminded Alester that after Maron and Lyarra died, the royal family opened its doors to him and raised him alongside her own children, a debt she knows he still carries.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Often the last voice able to temper the King's fury, though even she has limits; he struck her in a drunken rage and she withdrew from his bed for three days before Baelor persuaded her to return.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Often the last voice able to temper the King's fury, though even she has limits; he struck her in a drunken rage and she withdrew from his bed for three days before Baelor persuaded her to return.

baelor-targaryen.overview: Leaned on him during the worst of the family's fracturing; Baelor urged her gently to return to the King's side, and she listened.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Leaned on him during the worst of the family's fracturing; Baelor urged her gently to return to the King's side, and she listened.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Reminds him constantly that he is heir now, and that a prince wandering the city until dawn reeking of wine is unacceptable; loves him fiercely even while despairing of his judgment.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Reminds him constantly that he is heir now, and that a prince wandering the city until dawn reeking of wine is unacceptable; loves him fiercely even while despairing of his judgment.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Pinned the Hand's badge to his chest herself, telling him plainly that she is proud of him — one of the few moments anyone in the family has said so directly.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Pinned the Hand's badge to his chest herself, telling him plainly that she is proud of him — one of the few moments anyone in the family has said so directly.

lorenah-dayne.overview: She watched Lorenah's growing place beside Jace with the wary interest of both queen and mother.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: Jaery questioned why the Dornish lady remained at court, but by the Dragonstone reunion her presence beside Jace had become too serious to dismiss as a passing amusement.

maela-targaryen.overview: Actively arranging her marriage prospects; sent her to Storm's End to meet the Young Stag and considers the visit at least diplomatically productive.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Actively arranging her marriage prospects; sent her to Storm's End to meet the Young Stag and considers the visit at least diplomatically productive.

saera-targaryen.overview: Quietly approved her return to Winterfell even before Baelenys had been told, assuring Saera that she would handle the King herself because she knew how happy the journey made her daughter.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Quietly approved her return to Winterfell even before Baelenys had been told, assuring Saera that she would handle the King herself because she knew how happy the journey made her daughter.

steffon-baratheon.overview: She witnessed Steffon's disastrous audience with Jace and openly mocked the Young Stag's lack of tact.
steffon-baratheon.latestDevelopment: Even so, Jaery considered House Baratheon seriously enough to send Maela to Storm's End as a possible marriage match.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: Her youngest, whom she shelters as much as possible from the ugliness radiating out of the throne room.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her youngest, whom she shelters as much as possible from the ugliness radiating out of the throne room.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Desperate for news of her missing son; wept openly and begged Jace to keep searching.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Desperate for news of her missing son; wept openly and begged Jace to keep searching.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: When Rhaella was twelve, Jaery told the former hostage that she loved her as a daughter, believed no one better suited to Visenor and hoped Rhaella would one day follow her as queen.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: When Rhaella was twelve, Jaery told the former hostage that she loved her as a daughter, believed no one better suited to Visenor and hoped Rhaella would one day follow her as queen.

summary: News that her brother Vaenarr stands beside Vahaemon triggers a bitter confrontation with Baelenys. Jaery insists that she never returned Vaenarr's feelings and that Baelenys knowingly spared him despite understanding her love for the King. Their argument becomes another rupture in the royal marriage, while Vhaemys overhears fragments outside the chamber and draws the wrong conclusions about her mother.

name: Lorenah Dayne
title: Lady Lorenah Dayne of Torrentine
goals: Protect House Dayne's neutrality without appearing to take sides
Shelter Visenor and Rhaella without dragging Starfall into open war
Build a life with Jacaelon after accepting his marriage proposal
Navigate the political consequences of becoming the Hand's intended wife
Return to Dorne with the future of the match still to be settled between their houses

alester-dayne.overview: A distant cousin from another branch of House Dayne; her household's network almost certainly saved his life, and she managed his unauthorized role in the whole affair with characteristic competence.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: A distant cousin from another branch of House Dayne; her household's network almost certainly saved his life, and she managed his unauthorized role in the whole affair with characteristic competence.

daria-sand.overview: Her maid and discreet spy in King's Landing.
daria-sand.latestDevelopment: Daria gathers information among servants and in Flea Bottom, and most recently warned Lorenah about Gaelor and Cordin's alliance, Naella's pressure on Gaelor, and Weylar Rocke's increasingly conspicuous drunken behavior.

darren-dayne.overview: Her father, Lord Darren Dayne of Torrentine, who has tried to keep his family clear of King's Landing's political storms even as Lorenah has become deeply entangled in them.
darren-dayne.latestDevelopment: Her father, Lord Darren Dayne of Torrentine, who has tried to keep his family clear of King's Landing's political storms even as Lorenah has become deeply entangled in them.

edmyn-uller.overview: She dispatched Edmyn to the scholars' retreat to tend Visenor and Rhaella, trusting his competence and discretion with a secret that could endanger House Dayne.
edmyn-uller.latestDevelopment: His reports have made him one of the practical supports holding her sanctuary together.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: She has little direct affection for Gaelor and increasingly understands him as the dangerous center of the faction forming against Jace.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Through Daria's reports, Lorenah has learned of Gaelor's alliance with Cordin and the effort to watch Jace's inner circle.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Their relationship has become a betrothal. In the Cloudpass valley Jace proposed with a necklace made from Cloudgazer's shed horn-scales, and Lorenah accepted through tears, telling him that her happiness came from spending her life beside him rather than from becoming a princess.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Tells him what Daria learned about Cordin's surveillance and Gaelor's coming Watch appointment during their evening together.

jaery-targaryen.overview: She knows Jaery as both Jace's mother and the queen whose judgment will matter to any future marriage.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Lorenah has felt the Queen's scrutiny as her place beside Jace became increasingly public, even if Jaery has not openly opposed the match.

naella-velaryon.overview: She has little direct relationship with Naella, but has unknowingly become one of the princess's political concerns.
naella-velaryon.latestDevelopment: Naella sees Jace's intended wife as a possible second enemy and has encouraged Gaelor to watch the pair as a unit.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: News reaches Lorenah that Rhaella has failed to return to Starfall for a full day.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Lorenah does not know she is dead and begins arranging a quiet search through Dayne men before returning south herself.

saera-targaryen.overview: She increasingly sees Saera as an ally rather than merely Jace's formidable sister.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Saera helped arrange the Cloudpass proposal, guarded the moment from interruption, and watched with genuine happiness when Lorenah accepted.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: Their first meeting began with Vhaemys's hostility and jealousy.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: During Jace's proposal outing Lorenah kissed the little princess's cheek and personally fastened a pair of Cloudgazer-horn earrings on her, beginning a small but genuine thaw.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Granted him and Rhaella sanctuary at Starfall fully aware of what it could cost House Dayne if discovered; told him plainly that at some point he will have to leave.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Granted him and Rhaella sanctuary at Starfall fully aware of what it could cost House Dayne if discovered; told him plainly that at some point he will have to leave.

nymos.overview: The younger maester's name alarms Lorenah because she has never heard of him despite his supposed service at Starfall.
nymos.latestDevelopment: His disappearance with Rhaella makes him a central object of her investigation.

summary: Still troubled by the crisis at Starfall, Lorenah considers going south herself, but Jace refuses to support the risk and reminds her that she already gave Visenor and Rhaella more shelter than anyone could demand. She learns that Baelenys has ordered Jace to kill Visenya and Naela in Essos and calls the mission madness. Their own Dorne journey remains delayed while they wait for news.

name: Maela Targaryen
title: Princess Maela of House Targaryen
goals: Keep control over her own future, marriage included
Protect Jace, even from himself
Bury the secret of what happened with Vance
Survive whatever Gaelor did on her behalf without having to be grateful for it

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Her father and King.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His expectations form part of the dynastic pressure surrounding her future, though Queen Jaery has taken the more active role in arranging marriage prospects.

brannyn-vance.overview: Her sworn Kingsguard shield; she initiated the affair that destroyed him and now carries the weight of not knowing exactly what Gaelor did afterward.
brannyn-vance.latestDevelopment: Her sworn Kingsguard shield; she initiated the affair that destroyed him and now carries the weight of not knowing exactly what Gaelor did afterward.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Her relationship with Gaelor has curdled into anger and unease since he discovered her with Vance and handled the aftermath without her permission or input.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: She threw scalding moon tea in his face and does not consider them even.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Her twin and his greatest emotional vulnerability; she told him plainly that he won the tourney tilt even as he lay in the infirmary.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her twin and his greatest emotional vulnerability; she told him plainly that he won the tourney tilt even as he lay in the infirmary.

jaery-targaryen.overview: Her mother actively arranged marriage prospects and ultimately sent her to Storm's End; Maela went, played her part, and returned hollow.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her mother actively arranged marriage prospects and ultimately sent her to Storm's End; Maela went, played her part, and returned hollow.

saera-targaryen.overview: Suspects something is wrong with Maela that predates the tourney; has not yet found the right moment to press.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Suspects something is wrong with Maela that predates the tourney; has not yet found the right moment to press.

steffon-baratheon.overview: Charmed by his awkward, oblivious chivalry at Storm's End, though she has no real interest in becoming his lady; laughed aloud when he offered to fetch her a dragon from Dragonstone.
steffon-baratheon.latestDevelopment: Charmed by his awkward, oblivious chivalry at Storm's End, though she has no real interest in becoming his lady; laughed aloud when he offered to fetch her a dragon from Dragonstone.

vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Maela is fond of her, though Vhaemys is still too young to understand much of the turmoil surrounding Maela and the rest of the family.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Named his surviving hatchling Jadefyre before his flight; the dragon was gifted to her by royal decree after the other two died.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Named his surviving hatchling Jadefyre before his flight; the dragon was gifted to her by royal decree after the other two died.

summary: Born only two minutes before Jace, Maela shares an unusually close bond with her twin. Clever, charismatic, and naturally manipulative, she was gifted Jadefyre after the other two hatchlings of Visenor's clutch died of grotesque birth defects. Pressured by her mother to consider suitors, she used a visit to Storm's End to entertain the earnest Steffon Baratheon while quietly seducing her own Kingsguard, Ser Brannyn Vance — then drank moon tea in secret to ensure the night left no trace. Gaelor found them, killed Vance in the black cells with Blackfyre, and kept the secret. Maela is still not certain which of those facts frightens her more.

name: Malaenar Targaryen
title: Lord of Dragonstone
goals: Hold Dragonstone quietly in the King's name
Remain above the intrigues consuming his brother's children
Avoid ever repeating his other brother's fate

aenys-targaryen-ii.overview: At seventeen, Malaenar was subjected to one of his father's cruellest humiliations: Aenys forced him to crawl for the right to keep a small dragon, then ordered Sheepstealer to kill it in front of him.
aenys-targaryen-ii.latestDevelopment: At seventeen, Malaenar was subjected to one of his father's cruellest humiliations: Aenys forced him to crawl for the right to keep a small dragon, then ordered Sheepstealer to kill it in front of him.

alysa-targaryen.overview: His late wife, who died before Tansy Riverside entered his life on Dragonstone.
alysa-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His late wife, who died before Tansy Riverside entered his life on Dragonstone.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: As a boy, Baelenys witnessed Aenys destroy Malaenar's dragon and failed to act when Malaenar begged him for help.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The memory still returns to Baelenys in nightmares decades later.

baran-strong.overview: He has kept Baran as his sworn sword on Dragonstone and rates him among the finest knights in the realm.
baran-strong.latestDevelopment: Malaenar is openly reluctant to lose him even when the royal princes begin drawing Baran back toward King's Landing.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: He sees in Gaelor another young Targaryen being pulled toward the same dynastic wounds that scarred Malaenar's own generation.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The Dragonstone nameday brought the prince into the middle of arguments over succession, Vahaemon, and Baelenys's old violence.

tansy-riverside.overview: His companion of two years, who organized the nameday feast that summoned the royal family without telling him first; he was heavily drunk throughout and seemed more amused than alarmed by the chaos that followed.
tansy-riverside.latestDevelopment: His companion of two years, who organized the nameday feast that summoned the royal family without telling him first; he was heavily drunk throughout and seemed more amused than alarmed by the chaos that followed.

vahaemon-targaryen.overview: His other brother, whose treason and exile still cast a long shadow over the family name.
vahaemon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His other brother, whose treason and exile still cast a long shadow over the family name.

queen-vhaemys-targaryen.overview: His mother, the late Queen Vhaemys Targaryen, whose suffering under Aenys remained one of the old wounds later reopened between Malaenar and Baelenys.
queen-vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His mother, the late Queen Vhaemys Targaryen, whose suffering under Aenys remained one of the old wounds later reopened between Malaenar and Baelenys.

summary: The eldest of Aenys Targaryen II's three sons, Malaenar has long been remembered as the steady lord who renounced the throne because of his infirmity. Baelenys's nightmare reveals one of the deepest reasons the old family wounds never healed: at seventeen, Malaenar secretly obtained a small dragon, only for Aenys to force him to crawl across the Dragonpit floor and then order Sheepstealer to kill the beast before him. Malaenar begged young Baelenys to intervene, but his brother froze and fled.

name: Naella Velaryon
title: Princess Naella
goals: Support Gaelor through the weight of his position as heir
Bear a healthy child
Protect Gaelor from Jace's growing political power
Have Jace and Lorenah watched before they can coordinate against Gaelor
Draw Maester Cordin firmly into Gaelor's camp

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Told the King herself that she was with child; he received the news with an awkward but sincere paternal warmth — a pat on the cheek and two words of approval.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Told the King herself that she was with child; he received the news with an awkward but sincere paternal warmth — a pat on the cheek and two words of approval.

cordin-poole.overview: Identified Cordin as a courtier who could be brought firmly into Gaelor's camp and encouraged her husband to approach him for help monitoring Jace.
cordin-poole.latestDevelopment: Identified Cordin as a courtier who could be brought firmly into Gaelor's camp and encouraged her husband to approach him for help monitoring Jace.

daria-sand.overview: Unknown to Naella, Daria learned through another maid that she had been urging Gaelor to move more aggressively against Jace and passed the information to Lorenah.
daria-sand.latestDevelopment: Unknown to Naella, Daria learned through another maid that she had been urging Gaelor to move more aggressively against Jace and passed the information to Lorenah.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Her husband since their wedding at Driftmark; she sees past his bravado to the weight he carries as heir.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: She is now carrying his child — news she brought to him directly, and then to the King herself.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: No longer sees him merely as the brother who injured Gaelor in the lists.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Naella now considers Jace an escalating political threat who may one day wound Gaelor beyond recovery, and she personally urged that he and his inner circle be followed.

lorenah-dayne.overview: Views Lorenah with immediate suspicion, reasoning that anyone Jace chooses as a wife may be as resentful and dangerous as he is.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: She warned Gaelor that one enemy could become two once the pair marry.

summary: Naella Velaryon remains Gaelor's warmest private refuge, but pregnancy has not made her politically passive. She has become increasingly alarmed by Jace's power and by the appearance of Lorenah Dayne at his side, arguing that marriage could turn one dangerous rival into two. Naella urged Gaelor to have Jace and his circle followed and specifically identified Maester Cordin as a man who could be won over. Gaelor acted on that advice within hours. Her priority is no longer simply keeping peace between the brothers; it is ensuring that Gaelor survives the struggle she now believes is coming.

name: Rhaella Targaryen
title: Princess Rhaella of House Targaryen

secret.note: Killed near Starfall on the Fifteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC. After Boneskin burned the men who attacked her, the grievously wounded Rhaella commanded the dragon to burn her as well. Visenor does not yet know that his wife and unborn child are dead.

alester-dayne.overview: Watched him nearly die protecting her and Visenor, and has called him a true hero to the realm ever since.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Watched him nearly die protecting her and Visenor, and has called him a true hero to the realm ever since.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Feared him during her life; his threats drove her and Visenor into flight and concealment.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Feared him during her life; his threats drove her and Visenor into flight and concealment.

edmyn-uller.overview: The maester who confirmed her pregnancy.
edmyn-uller.latestDevelopment: His unexplained absence causes her growing distress in her final days; she receives no confirmed news of his fate.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Jace receives word that she has gone missing near Starfall and quietly sends Weylar to investigate.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He does not yet know that Rhaella and her unborn child are dead.

lorenah-dayne.overview: Lorenah receives the same report of Rhaella's disappearance and begins quietly mobilizing her father's men, unaware that the princess has already died near Boneskin's cave.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: Lorenah receives the same report of Rhaella's disappearance and begins quietly mobilizing her father's men, unaware that the princess has already died near Boneskin's cave.

naela-targaryen.overview: Her mother, Princess Naela Targaryen, whose present whereabouts and condition are unknown.
naela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her mother, Princess Naela Targaryen, whose present whereabouts and condition are unknown.

vahaemon-targaryen.overview: Her exiled father, whose disgrace hangs over her at court, though it was not to him that her secret warning was sent — it was to her siblings.
vahaemon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her exiled father, whose disgrace hangs over her at court, though it was not to him that her secret warning was sent — it was to her siblings.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Her husband and greatest love.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: She died near Starfall while he was operating secretly in the Reach, before learning whether his coded raven had reached her; Visenor remains unaware of her death and that of their unborn child.

visenya-targaryen.overview: Her sister, whose current whereabouts and allegiances remain unknown to Rhaella.
visenya-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her sister, whose current whereabouts and allegiances remain unknown to Rhaella.

nymos.overview: The younger maester she questions about Edmyn's disappearance and Lorenah's safety.
nymos.latestDevelopment: He understands her guarded questions and agrees to arrange food for the villages.

jaery-targaryen.overview: At twelve, Rhaella was told by Jaery that she was loved as a daughter and destined to stand beside Visenor as queen.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Rhaella vowed that every breath she drew would be for the prince.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: Knew Vhaemys from infancy, when the screaming baby was already called the Dragonet.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Rhaella instinctively tried to comfort her during the conversation in which Jaery promised Rhaella a future beside Visenor.

aegor-targaryen.overview: Her brother, revealed in Essos after her death as the dragonrider known as the Young Dragon.
aegor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Rhaella never lives to see what Vahaemon has built around him.

summary: Daughter of the exiled Vahaemon Targaryen and wife of Crown Prince Visenor, Rhaella lived in hiding near Starfall under House Dayne's protection while carrying Visenor's child. On the Fifteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, riders attacked her near Boneskin's cave. The dragon burned her assailants, but Rhaella had been grievously wounded. She blocked Boneskin's path and repeatedly commanded Dracarys until the dragon understood, dying with her unborn child in the fire. Visenor remains unaware of their deaths.

name: Rickard Stark
title: Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North
goals: Rule the North well in his father's stead
Mend the old distance between Winterfell and the Iron Throne
Win Princess Saera's love
Offer Saera a future beside him in the North
Convince her that Winterfell can become the refuge from court life she desires

alester-dayne.overview: Recognizes the Kingsguard's attachment to Saera and deliberately pressed on it during a private walk through the snow.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Rickard told Alester that he alone could offer Saera the North, security, and a place to rule; their exchange remained courteous but openly competitive beneath the surface.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Knows that the Crown's regard for House Stark rests partly on an older debt: his grandfather Edwyle aided King Aenys in ways Baelenys still considers important.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Rickard now seeks a steadier relationship between Winterfell and the Iron Throne.

benjen-stark.overview: His fifteen-year-old younger brother, a talented archer and hunter whom Rickard trusts to represent Winterfell in his absence.
benjen-stark.latestDevelopment: His fifteen-year-old younger brother, a talented archer and hunter whom Rickard trusts to represent Winterfell in his absence.

brandon-stark.overview: His father and predecessor as Lord of Winterfell.
brandon-stark.latestDevelopment: Brandon's quiet death in 99 AC abruptly left the twenty-three-year-old Rickard with Winterfell and the wardenship of the North.

edwyle-stark.overview: His paternal grandfather and a former Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North.
edwyle-stark.latestDevelopment: Edwyle's important service to King Aenys created an old bond between Winterfell and the Crown that still benefited Rickard's generation.

mother-marya.overview: Trusted the mysterious old servant to assist with Saera's private gift.
mother-marya.latestDevelopment: Marya's herbs briefly restored the princess's sight while Rickard knelt before her with the white direwolf pup.

saera-targaryen.overview: His feelings are now unmistakable. Rickard told Alester that he intends, when the time comes, to offer Saera the entire North beside him.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He prepared a white direwolf pup as a gift, and when Mother Marya briefly restored Saera's sight, she saw him kneeling with the pup before embracing him.

summary: Rickard Stark is no longer merely a grieving young Lord of Winterfell cautiously drawn to a visiting princess. He has decided what he wants. When Saera returned to Winterfell with Alester, Rickard spent nearly all of his available time with her and privately told the Kingsguard that he intends one day to offer Saera the whole North beside him. He believes Winterfell can give her the peace and dignity she cannot find in the Red Keep. His rivalry with Alester remains unspoken but obvious to both men. On the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, Rickard brought Saera a white direwolf pup. With Mother Marya's strange herbal aid, Saera saw clearly for several seconds and looked directly upon Rickard and his gift before embracing him in the snow.

name: Saera Targaryen
title: Princess Saera of House Targaryen
goals: Maintain the family's fragile unity
Protect Visenor and Rhaella however she can from afar
Resist being weaponized as a dragonrider in a succession war she did not start
Understand what future, if any, she wants with Rickard Stark
Preserve her bond with Alester without forcing him into choices he cannot make
Understand Mother Marya's strange ability to briefly restore her sight

alester-dayne.overview: Alester returns from Winterfell convinced that Saera has chosen Rickard and the North, though he has still never spoken plainly to her.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Jace learns of the situation and decides to speak with Saera himself.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Frequently opposes the King's decisions and is the only child willing to do so in open court; called him out publicly over the Oldtown Massacre and earned a threat of the black cells for it.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Frequently opposes the King's decisions and is the only child willing to do so in open court; called him out publicly over the Oldtown Massacre and earned a threat of the black cells for it.

baelor-targaryen.overview: Working alongside him to find a way to frame the Tyrosh campaign that Saera might actually agree to; she remains resistant to being used as a weapon in a war of succession.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Working alongside him to find a way to frame the Tyrosh campaign that Saera might actually agree to; she remains resistant to being used as a weapon in a war of succession.

benjen-stark.overview: Greeted Rickard's fifteen-year-old younger brother with an immediate embrace when she returned to Winterfell and treated him with easy familiarity.
benjen-stark.latestDevelopment: Greeted Rickard's fifteen-year-old younger brother with an immediate embrace when she returned to Winterfell and treated him with easy familiarity.

brandon-stark.overview: The late Lord of Winterfell whose death first brought her north on the Crown's behalf.
brandon-stark.latestDevelopment: Baelenys sent Saera specifically because the Starks favored her, while also invoking the old debt owed to Brandon's father Edwyle.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Called him a deranged psychopath before the King after the Oldtown Massacre; the relationship has not recovered.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Called him a deranged psychopath before the King after the Oldtown Massacre; the relationship has not recovered.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: One of the siblings she trusts most.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Saera helped Jace stage his marriage proposal to Lorenah and ensured Vhaemys did not spoil the moment before departing for Winterfell.

jaery-targaryen.overview: Her mother, who quietly enabled Saera's return to Winterfell before Baelenys had even been told and promised to handle the King herself.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her mother, who quietly enabled Saera's return to Winterfell before Baelenys had even been told and promised to handle the King herself.

lorenah-dayne.overview: She has grown from Jace's formidable sister into one of Lorenah's clearest allies at court.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: Saera helped arrange the Cloudpass proposal, guarded the moment from interruption, and watched with genuine happiness when Lorenah accepted.

maela-targaryen.overview: Suspects something is wrong beneath her sister's hollow composure; has not yet learned what.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Suspects something is wrong beneath her sister's hollow composure; has not yet learned what.

mother-marya.overview: The blind old servant used the vapor of a herbal drink to clear Saera's clouded eyes for several seconds, allowing her to see perfectly for the first time in years.
mother-marya.latestDevelopment: The blind old servant used the vapor of a herbal drink to clear Saera's clouded eyes for several seconds, allowing her to see perfectly for the first time in years.

rickard-stark.overview: Alester tells Jace that Saera made Rickard a promise and interprets the direwolf and her attachment to the North as signs of a future marriage.
rickard-stark.latestDevelopment: The exact meaning of Saera's promise remains hers to explain.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: Her youngest sister, whom Saera instinctively protects when the Red Keep becomes frightening.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Vhaemys often gravitates toward Saera when Jace or Alester are unavailable, and Saera tries to shield her from the family's worst influences.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Supported him during the Rhaella affair and helped shield the truth from their father as long as she could.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Supported him during the Rhaella affair and helped shield the truth from their father as long as she could.

summary: On the Twenty-First Day of the Eighth Moon, Saera takes an exhausted and distressed Vhaemys into the storm on Cloudgazer, with Jace riding behind them. Above King's Landing they physically encounter an enormous unidentified white dragon. Cloudgazer panics and prepares flame before Saera calms her; the white dragon then turns its attention to Vhaemys. Saera and Jace both think of Meraxes, but neither speaks the name and the resemblance remains unconfirmed.

name: Ser Alester Dayne
title: Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard
goals: Protect Jace
Protect Saera throughout the Winterfell journey
Honor House Dayne
Survive long enough to answer for abandoning his post
Understand what he truly wants from Saera before Rickard's courtship closes the door
Reconcile his Northern blood with the home he actually knows in King's Landing

baran-strong.overview: He met Baran on Dragonstone and endured the older knight's jab about the Kingsguard favoring pretty faces with characteristic calm.
baran-strong.latestDevelopment: Alester took the measure of his size and confidence, but refused to be baited.

benjen-stark.overview: Was welcomed to Winterfell by Rickard's younger brother, who pointedly called Alester a child of the North through his Karstark mother.
benjen-stark.latestDevelopment: Was welcomed to Winterfell by Rickard's younger brother, who pointedly called Alester a child of the North through his Karstark mother.

brant-costayne.overview: He recognized Costayne as one of Oldtown's surviving knights after the assassination attempt in the lists.
brant-costayne.latestDevelopment: Alester later accompanied Jace into the black cells, placing him close to both Costayne's grievance and the Crown's judgment of it.

cordin-poole.overview: He has become the subject of Cordin's quiet investigation after Gaelor suggested that Alester may be the blond knight connected to Curtass Whent's death.
cordin-poole.latestDevelopment: Alester does not yet know how seriously the maester is pursuing the accusation.

curtass-whent.overview: Ambushed by him and five sellswords in the Dornish woods; Whent beat him nearly to death before a desperate act involving the warhorse's testicles ended the fight.
curtass-whent.latestDevelopment: The ugliest duel of his life.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: He is now under Gaelor's suspicion for Curtass Whent's death.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Gaelor fed Cordin a deliberately strengthened version of the evidence and ordered the maester to investigate whether Alester was the unidentified blond knight.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Their friendship survives an ugly spar in which Alester splits Jace's lip.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Jace forces him to admit the truth about Saera, berates him for deciding her feelings without speaking and promises to intervene only by talking to her, not by choosing for her.

jaery-targaryen.overview: The Queen entrusted Saera directly to him before the Winterfell journey and reminded him that the royal family took him in and raised him alongside her children after both his parents died.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The Queen entrusted Saera directly to him before the Winterfell journey and reminded him that the royal family took him in and raised him alongside her children after both his parents died.

lorenah-dayne.overview: A distant cousin whose protection at Starfall likely saved both his life and the fugitive prince's; she knew his role long before he admitted it.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: A distant cousin whose protection at Starfall likely saved both his life and the fugitive prince's; she knew his role long before he admitted it.

lyarra-karstark.overview: His Northern mother. Her marriage to Maron began as a political arrangement and apparently became more genuine.
lyarra-karstark.latestDevelopment: She survived Maron for nearly two years before dying late in 92 AC, leaving Alester orphaned at eleven.

maron-dayne.overview: His father, killed by Dornishmen early in 91 AC when Alester was nine.
maron-dayne.latestDevelopment: The exact circumstances remain unresolved, but Alester has said that the only reason he himself survived what followed was King Baelenys.

mother-marya.overview: Met the blind old servant while walking alone in Winterfell's snow.
mother-marya.latestDevelopment: Marya used a rare glass-like flower to give him a cryptic warning about beauty, thorns, and the burden of care, then welcomed him home.

orwell-morrigen.overview: Orwell intervenes when Alester's spar with Jace becomes too violent, slaps him after noticing Baelenys watching and sharply reminds him of the distance between a knight and a prince.
orwell-morrigen.latestDevelopment: Orwell intervenes when Alester's spar with Jace becomes too violent, slaps him after noticing Baelenys watching and sharply reminds him of the distance between a knight and a prince.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: He nearly died twice protecting Rhaella and Visenor on the road south.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Rhaella has since spoken of him as a true hero of the realm, while Alester regards the ordeal simply as the duty he accepted when Jace entrusted them to him.

rickard-stark.overview: A courteous but increasingly painful rival for Saera's affection. Rickard privately told Alester that he intends to offer Saera the entire North and can give her what no one else can.
rickard-stark.latestDevelopment: Alester answered that Saera is a dragon, not a wolf, but could not say more.

saathos-maris.overview: Traded barbed pleasantries with him in the infirmary; the two understand each other's roles perfectly and trust each other roughly as far as their princes allow.
saathos-maris.latestDevelopment: Traded barbed pleasantries with him in the infirmary; the two understand each other's roles perfectly and trust each other roughly as far as their princes allow.

saera-targaryen.overview: His feelings finally become explicit to Jace after the Winterfell journey.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Alester believes Saera loves Rickard and has promised him a future in the North, yet admits he never clearly told her what he wanted from her.

steffon-baratheon.overview: Faced him in the tourney semi-finals in what witnesses called one of the finest jousts the realm had seen in years; lost in the final pass to a two-handed lance thrust to the gut, and shook the man's hand from the dirt.
steffon-baratheon.latestDevelopment: Faced him in the tourney semi-finals in what witnesses called one of the finest jousts the realm had seen in years; lost in the final pass to a two-handed lance thrust to the gut, and shook the man's hand from the dirt.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: The little princess adores him and did not stop asking after him the entire time he was gone; he owes her several stories.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The little princess adores him and did not stop asking after him the entire time he was gone; he owes her several stories.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Escorted him and Rhaella out of King's Landing under cover of darkness and nearly died protecting them twice over; considers the debt repaid by Visenor's own courage through the journey.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Escorted him and Rhaella out of King's Landing under cover of darkness and nearly died protecting them twice over; considers the debt repaid by Visenor's own courage through the journey.

visenya-targaryen.overview: He burst into Jace's chamber while Visenya held Dark Sister to the prince's throat and physically grappled with her as she fled.
visenya-targaryen.latestDevelopment: She slipped his grip, nearly cut him with a concealed dagger, and escaped into King's Landing before he and Jace could catch her.

summary: Back in King's Landing, Alester's misery over Saera finally breaks into the open. Jace provokes him into a hard sparring match that leaves Jace bloodied and draws Orwell Morrigen's intervention. Alester admits he believes Saera loves Rickard Stark, that she made the northern lord a promise, and that Queen Jaery's earlier conversation left him feeling like a mere household knight who had no right to speak. Jace rejects that resignation and promises to talk to Saera, leaving Alester to confront the fact that he never truly told her what he wanted.

name: Ser Brannyn Vance
title: Former Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Discovered, dragged to the black cells, and executed with Blackfyre in a humiliating fight Vance refused to fully participate in. He asked only to die with some remnant of honor.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He was not given it.

maela-targaryen.overview: Sworn to protect her with his life; broke his sacred vows for her in a single night and confessed, under threat, that she initiated the affair.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Did not fight back when Gaelor came for him.

summary: Ser Brannyn Vance served as Princess Maela's sworn shield long enough to become someone she trusted with more than her safety. He broke his Kingsguard vows in a single night in Storm's End and spent the journey home wracked with guilt, terrified of what came next. What came next was Prince Gaelor — through the door, across the room, and eventually down to the black cells. Vance died on Blackfyre's edge, castrated and then killed, having refused on principle to raise steel against royal blood. He is officially listed as a traitor. Only three people know the truth of what happened.

name: Ser Brant Costayne
title: Knight of the Reach

secret.note: Imprisoned in the black cells of the Red Keep following his assassination attempt on Prince Gaelor in the tourney lists. Gaelor has claimed him personally.

alester-dayne.overview: He encountered Alester after the tourney assassination attempt and again when the Kingsguard accompanied Jace into the black cells.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Costayne has no personal quarrel with him, but Alester stood physically beside the Crown while Costayne answered for Oldtown.

berholt-caswell.overview: He found an unexpected measure of understanding in Berholt.
berholt-caswell.latestDevelopment: The High Septon saw in Costayne a man who acted on conviction where Berholt himself had hesitated, and that recognition helped move him toward mercy.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: The prince he blamed for Oldtown.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Brant finally faced Gaelor in trial by combat on the Twentieth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC; he wounded Gaelor's left arm but was defeated, beheaded and killed in the yard.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Jace offered him another path out of the black cells, but Brant refused and chose to wait for Gaelor.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Jace then forced the delayed trial to a conclusion; Brant died in the combat that followed.

timos-hightower.overview: Swore to defend him under oath and screamed for his revenge the moment the boy was executed; the grief has not dimmed.
timos-hightower.latestDevelopment: Swore to defend him under oath and screamed for his revenge the moment the boy was executed; the grief has not dimmed.

summary: A hard-edged survivor of the Oldtown Massacre, Brant Costayne entered the King's Landing tourney in disguise and nearly killed Gaelor before being taken alive. He refused Jace's attempt to find another path and insisted upon the trial by combat he had demanded. On the Twentieth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, he fought Gaelor before the Crown and a hostile crowd, wounded the prince's left forearm badly, but was eventually cut down and beheaded. His death ended the long-delayed judgment he had sought in the name of Oldtown.

name: Ser Orwell Morrigen
title: Lord Commander of the Kingsguard
goals: Hold the Kingsguard together through scandal and desertion
Protect the royal family whatever the cost to his own men
Eventually address what Alester Dayne did and did not do

alester-dayne.overview: He breaks up Alester's overly violent spar with Jace, slaps his former pupil when he notices Baelenys watching, and reminds him that however close they are, a knight cannot forget the distance between himself and a prince.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: He breaks up Alester's overly violent spar with Jace, slaps his former pupil when he notices Baelenys watching, and reminds him that however close they are, a knight cannot forget the distance between himself and a prince.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Serves him with rigid, unquestioning discipline.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Serves him with rigid, unquestioning discipline.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Trained the prince rigorously in Alester's absence; openly assessed him ready for knighthood, told him he could not quite beat Alester yet but was close, and watched Jace choose Alester's hand over his for the ceremony itself. The slight was real.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He showed no sign of minding.

reyenald-reyne.overview: Trains the talented young swordsman and warns him against arrogance.
reyenald-reyne.latestDevelopment: Trains the talented young swordsman and warns him against arrogance.

lucas-corbray.overview: Welcomes his fellow Kingsguard back from the Vale and entrusts Vhaemys to him.
lucas-corbray.latestDevelopment: Welcomes his fellow Kingsguard back from the Vale and entrusts Vhaemys to him.

oswald-eagle.overview: Reassures Oswald that he is not being judged for Gaelor's orders and helps the council discuss the Watch's conduct after the massacre.
oswald-eagle.latestDevelopment: Reassures Oswald that he is not being judged for Gaelor's orders and helps the council discuss the Watch's conduct after the massacre.

summary: Lord Commander Orwell Morrigen has led the Kingsguard through decades of relative peace, none of which prepared him for a poisoning, a vanished heir, and one of his own sworn brothers quietly abandoning his post to smuggle that heir out of the capital. He says little, watches everything, and is running out of patience for secrets he is clearly not being told. He trained both Alester Dayne and Prince Jacaelon; the latter chose his sworn shield's sword over his Lord Commander's for the knighting ceremony, which Morrigen absorbed in silence and has not mentioned since. He privately trains thirteen-year-old Reyenald Reyne, warning him against arrogance, before Vhaemys interrupts. He welcomes Lucas Corbray back from the Vale and leaves the princess in his care.

name: Ser Saathos Maris
title: Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard
goals: Serve Prince Gaelor faithfully
Keep his prince alive despite his own recklessness
Uncover who the blonde knight was that killed Curtass Whent
