alester-dayne.overview: Suspects, based on his investigation of the sept and the description of the surviving blonde knight, that Dayne is connected to Curtass Whent's death; has not yet formally accused anyone.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Their infirmary exchange was pleasant and meant nothing at all.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Rode at Gaelor's side through Oldtown and carried out the King's orders.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Rode at Gaelor's side through Oldtown and carried out the King's orders.

baelor-targaryen.overview: Chosen by Baelor to ride south and investigate the deaths of Ser Curtass Whent and his men near the rural sept; his findings confirmed the broad outlines of an ambush but not the identity of the surviving knight.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Chosen by Baelor to ride south and investigate the deaths of Ser Curtass Whent and his men near the rural sept; his findings confirmed the broad outlines of an ambush but not the identity of the surviving knight.

baran-strong.overview: He knew Baran as the formidable knight stranded on Dragonstone and casually helped bring him to Gaelor's attention.
baran-strong.latestDevelopment: Their drinking conversation quickly turned toward Curtass Whent, old Kingsguard grievances, and Baran's hunger to return to action.

cordin-poole.overview: He has become one of Cordin's intended sources in the inquiry into Curtass Whent's death.
cordin-poole.latestDevelopment: Cordin plans to question him about the surviving report of a large blond knight near the scene.

curtass-whent.overview: He investigated Whent's death on Baelor's orders, tracing the bodies and testimony around the rural sept.
curtass-whent.latestDevelopment: His inquiries confirmed an ambush and a surviving blond knight, but not the killer's identity.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Sworn knight, loyal protector, and one of the few people willing to needle him with dark humor even in the worst moments; visited him in the infirmary after the tourney tilt and woke him up by slapping his shoulder.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Sworn knight, loyal protector, and one of the few people willing to needle him with dark humor even in the worst moments; visited him in the infirmary after the tourney tilt and woke him up by slapping his shoulder.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: He knows Jace chiefly as Gaelor's rival and the other prince around whom court tensions gather.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Their clearest direct clash came in the tourney, where Saathos shattered Jace's shield before Jace broke his arm and unhorsed him; the prince's immediate concern afterward tempered the humiliation.

summary: Ser Saathos Maris is the sworn knight of Prince Gaelor Targaryen. Disciplined, dependable, and unwavering in duty, he represents the military backbone of Gaelor's authority. During the poisoning crisis, he assisted in tracking the assassin and later defied political pressure by refusing the Hand entry into the dungeon. He rode at Gaelor's side through the bloody march on Oldtown and the massacre that followed. Sent south by Baelor Targaryen to investigate Curtass Whent's death, he returned with incomplete answers and a growing private suspicion about who the blonde knight at the sept really was — a suspicion he has not yet taken anywhere. On the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon he accompanies Gaelor through the Watch barracks and Flea Bottom. He brings six gold cloaks into a mummers' tent at the prince's command. When Gaelor kills two actors and the audience stampedes, Saathos uses his shield and sword flat, refusing to use the edge. Eighteen smallfolk die in the ensuing crush and violence.

name: Steffon Baratheon
title: Lord of Storm's End
goals: Win the Crown's respect for House Baratheon
Secure a marriage worthy of his house
Prove himself beyond the tourney grounds
Win the tourney — which he did, by default, after neither prince could stand

alester-dayne.overview: Faced him in the tourney semi-finals in one of the most brutal jousts in recent memory; won by throwing his own lance away and driving the butt end into Alester's stomach, then ran to his side the moment he fell.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: They embraced in the dirt to the crowd's approval.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Held in high esteem by the King for his house's past military service; Baelenys remains unaware of the insolence at the Hand's throne.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Held in high esteem by the King for his house's past military service; Baelenys remains unaware of the insolence at the Hand's throne.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Demanded overdue debts from him before the whole court and was humiliated for his trouble; was unhorsed by him in the tourney quarter-finals and correctly assessed that Jace was holding back.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Demanded overdue debts from him before the whole court and was humiliated for his trouble; was unhorsed by him in the tourney quarter-finals and correctly assessed that Jace was holding back.

jaery-targaryen.overview: He remembers the Queen as one of the people who made his humiliating audience with Jace worse, laughing that the Young Stag was still too young.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Yet her later decision to send Maela to Storm's End proved she had not dismissed him or House Baratheon entirely.

maela-targaryen.overview: Hosted her at Storm's End and fell for her completely, treating her with an awkward, earnest chivalry that charmed her even as she entertained his Kingsguard; offered to fetch her a dragon from Dragonstone without understanding why she laughed.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Hosted her at Storm's End and fell for her completely, treating her with an awkward, earnest chivalry that charmed her even as she entertained his Kingsguard; offered to fetch her a dragon from Dragonstone without understanding why she laughed.

summary: Already famous in tourneys and duels despite his youth, Steffon Baratheon marched into the Red Keep demanding the Crown repay House Baratheon's old debts in blood and coin, only to be cut down before the court by Hand Jacaelon Targaryen. Weeks later he hosted Princess Maela at Storm's End, showing an earnest, almost childlike chivalry that charmed her without ever earning her heart. He won the King's Landing tourney by default when both princes collapsed in the lists — a hollow victory he was loudly furious about. His joust against Alester Dayne, however, was anything but hollow.

name: Timos Hightower
title: Former Lord of Oldtown
goals: Survive the Crown's judgment
Protect his sisters
Preserve what remained of House Hightower's honor

alysanne-hightower.overview: His older sister, killed in the same massacre that claimed his life moments later.
alysanne-hightower.latestDevelopment: His older sister, killed in the same massacre that claimed his life moments later.

brant-costayne.overview: The knight who stood in oath to defend him, called for his revenge the moment he was killed, and died in the chaos that followed.
brant-costayne.latestDevelopment: The knight who stood in oath to defend him, called for his revenge the moment he was killed, and died in the chaos that followed.

derrin-hightower.overview: His father, whose secret treason condemned him before he understood what was happening.
derrin-hightower.latestDevelopment: His father, whose secret treason condemned him before he understood what was happening.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Asked him for parley and mercy; drew his sword in panic when the answer became clear; was beheaded.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Asked him for parley and mercy; drew his sword in panic when the answer became clear; was beheaded.

melessa-hightower.overview: His younger sister; she survived the massacre in which he died.
melessa-hightower.latestDevelopment: His younger sister; she survived the massacre in which he died.

summary: Thrust into Oldtown's lordship the moment his father vanished under suspicion, fifteen-year-old Timos Hightower tried desperately to comply with the Crown's demands. He asked Gaelor to enter with only a few men and speak. It was not enough. When the prince announced his execution, panic drove the boy to draw steel. He never had a chance to use it. His decapitated head rolled to a stop at Gaelor's boots. His death, and the massacre it triggered, will be remembered in the Reach for a hundred years.

name: Tion Lannister
title: Master of Coin
goals: Keep the Crown solvent
Temper the royal family's costlier impulses
Survive the King's temper long enough to matter
Prevent Highgarden's reparations from being immediately poured into a Stepstones war

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Regularly rebuked for prioritizing the treasury over the King's pride; was told to deal with the money and leave the rest to others.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Regularly rebuked for prioritizing the treasury over the King's pride; was told to deal with the money and leave the rest to others.

baelor-targaryen.overview: Works with him on the council's finances; their shared practicality occasionally makes them temporary allies.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Works with him on the council's finances; their shared practicality occasionally makes them temporary allies.

ella-lannister.overview: His mother, Lady of Casterly Rock.
ella-lannister.latestDevelopment: His mother, Lady of Casterly Rock.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Dismisses his war-hungry proposals as reckless, and is dismissed right back.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Dismisses his war-hungry proposals as reckless, and is dismissed right back.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Finds an unlikely, if uneasy, ally in the Hand's more measured economic instincts; the two agreed publicly in council that beheading a sixteen-year-old does not mend the Crown's image.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Finds an unlikely, if uneasy, ally in the Hand's more measured economic instincts; the two agreed publicly in council that beheading a sixteen-year-old does not mend the Crown's image.

tygett-lannister.overview: His father, Lord of Casterly Rock and Warden of the West.
tygett-lannister.latestDevelopment: His father, Lord of Casterly Rock and Warden of the West.

berholt-caswell.overview: Promises the Crown will assist with the sept's delayed works, while explaining that the required sums cannot be found in a single afternoon.
berholt-caswell.latestDevelopment: Promises the Crown will assist with the sept's delayed works, while explaining that the required sums cannot be found in a single afternoon.

summary: As Master of Coin, Tion Lannister spends most small council meetings being outvoted by princes eager for war and glory. He argued against pouring Highgarden's reparations straight into a campaign for the Stepstones, pointing out — correctly, and to no effect — that a war with no clear end is not an investment. He was the only voice at table to agree openly with Jace that executing a fifteen-year-old for his father's treason does not improve the Crown's reputation, a point the King ended by slamming his fist on the table. His counsel is sound and almost never followed.

name: Vahaemon Targaryen
title: Exiled Prince Vahaemon of House Targaryen

secret.note: Alive in Essos. Crown intelligence places him with Tyroshi/Triarchy support, Vaenarr, Aegor and multiple dragons, but this remains secret information.

goals: Build power in Essos beyond the Crown’s reach
Gather dragons and allies before confronting Baelenys
Use Tyrosh and the Triarchy to strengthen his future kingdom
Undo the bloodline curse his circle believes disrupts dragon bonds

aenys-targaryen-ii.overview: His father, King Aenys Targaryen II.
aenys-targaryen-ii.latestDevelopment: Vahaemon grew up as the youngest of Aenys' three sons in a family already marked by rivalry and violence.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: His brother and King, who exiled him for treason during the seventh moon of his own reign — a cold war ended decisively, the realm was told, though the full details remain known only to those who lived through it.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His brother and King, who exiled him for treason during the seventh moon of his own reign — a cold war ended decisively, the realm was told, though the full details remain known only to those who lived through it.

baelor-targaryen.overview: His uncle Baelor spent years studying Targaryen dreamers and the family's stranger histories at the Citadel.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Some of that abandoned research later passed indirectly into Visenor's hands and now touches the struggle surrounding Vahaemon's name.

grance-morrigen.overview: One of the knights who pulled him away from Maelwing while he screamed at Baelenys during the Ashenmist Valley incident of 56 AC.
grance-morrigen.latestDevelopment: One of the knights who pulled him away from Maelwing while he screamed at Baelenys during the Ashenmist Valley incident of 56 AC.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: His nephew has become one of the principal minds directing the Crown's effort against him.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Vahaemon may not know how much of the pressure campaign bears Jace's hand, but the conflict has already reached Jace directly through Visenya and Dark Sister.

malaenar-targaryen.overview: His steady brother, who stayed loyal to Baelenys throughout and whose very steadiness has always been the sharpest rebuke to Vahaemon's choices.
malaenar-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His steady brother, who stayed loyal to Baelenys throughout and whose very steadiness has always been the sharpest rebuke to Vahaemon's choices.

myles-mooton.overview: One of the knights who pulled him back from Maelwing during the disastrous Ashenmist Valley incident on his nameday in 56 AC.
myles-mooton.latestDevelopment: One of the knights who pulled him back from Maelwing during the disastrous Ashenmist Valley incident on his nameday in 56 AC.

naela-targaryen.overview: His wife; her current whereabouts and condition are unknown.
naela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His wife; her current whereabouts and condition are unknown.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: His daughter in exile; her secret letters to her siblings reignited the very suspicion that nearly destroyed her marriage, though the warning was never addressed to him.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His daughter in exile; her secret letters to her siblings reignited the very suspicion that nearly destroyed her marriage, though the warning was never addressed to him.

queen-vhaemys-targaryen.overview: His mother, the late Queen Vhaemys Targaryen.
queen-vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His mother, the late Queen Vhaemys Targaryen.

visenor-targaryen.overview: His nephew Visenor now treats Vahaemon's name as both a family danger and a political weapon.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Without Vahaemon's knowledge, Visenor has considered forging evidence of an alliance between him and the Gardeners to redirect the Crown's fury.

visenya-targaryen.overview: His daughter is back beside him in Essos after her unexplained appearance in King's Landing.
visenya-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Crown intelligence strongly suspects that she has a dragon of her own.

vaenarr-targaryen.overview: Queen Jaery's brother has joined Vahaemon in Essos and stands openly at his side as the exiled prince's preparations enter a new phase.
vaenarr-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Queen Jaery's brother has joined Vahaemon in Essos and stands openly at his side as the exiled prince's preparations enter a new phase.

aegor-targaryen.overview: His son, already known in Essos as the Young Dragon, rides the golden dragon Sunfyre and appears to be one of the central weapons in Vahaemon's long preparation for war.
aegor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His son, already known in Essos as the Young Dragon, rides the golden dragon Sunfyre and appears to be one of the central weapons in Vahaemon's long preparation for war.

summary: Vahaemon is no longer merely an exiled name whispered about in the Red Keep. The Crown's spies discover that he has spent years building a secret network in Essos, has been welcomed by Tyrosh and the Triarchy, has promised future council seats to influential Tyroshi men, and is involved with blood magic tied to a supposed curse upon the Targaryen bloodline. Vaenarr Targaryen now stands beside him, his son Aegor rides Sunfyre and at least three dragons are seen circling his camp. From a hill across the Narrow Sea, Vahaemon looks west toward the kingdom that cast him out.

name: Vhaemys Targaryen
title: Princess Vhaemys of House Targaryen

alester-dayne.overview: Deeply attached to him and often followed him around the castle before his disappearance; she missed him openly and without shame the entire time he was gone.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Deeply attached to him and often followed him around the castle before his disappearance; she missed him openly and without shame the entire time he was gone.

annara-celtigar.overview: Her closest friend at the Red Keep, a nine-year-old Celtigar girl who remains one of the few companions near Vhaemys's own age.
annara-celtigar.latestDevelopment: Her closest friend at the Red Keep, a nine-year-old Celtigar girl who remains one of the few companions near Vhaemys's own age.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: After a nightmare convinces her Baelenys has died, she must see him alive before she can calm down.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Baelenys comforts her and later calls her the family's most precious treasure.

daria-sand.overview: The maid Jace quietly tasked with watching Vhaemys and making certain she attended her lessons after the chaos in the royal kitchens.
daria-sand.latestDevelopment: The maid Jace quietly tasked with watching Vhaemys and making certain she attended her lessons after the chaos in the royal kitchens.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: The crowd's hatred of Gaelor during Brant Costayne's trial frightens her because it is hatred directed at her own family.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: When Gaelor wins, she cheers and looks to Baelenys for reassurance.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Runs to Jace after dreaming of Visenor shouting that someone has died amid fire.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: She trusts Jace with her repeating visions, including an immense white dragon she sees herself riding, and accepts his promise to listen to every dream.

jaery-targaryen.overview: Her mother, beside whom she sheltered during the worst of the family's fracturing.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her mother, beside whom she sheltered during the worst of the family's fracturing.

lorenah-dayne.overview: Still jealous of the attention Jace gives Lorenah, but their hostility has begun to thaw.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: During Jace's proposal outing Vhaemys allowed Lorenah to kiss her cheek and happily accepted earrings that Lorenah fastened for her, though she remained jealous of Lorenah's necklace.

maela-targaryen.overview: Her older sister and Jace's twin.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Vhaemys looks to Maela as another familiar presence within the royal family even if their bond has not yet been tested by the same crises as her attachments to Jace, Saera, Gaelor, and Alester.

rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: As a screaming baby already called the Dragonet, Vhaemys was instinctively comforted by her future sister-in-law during Jaery's promise that Rhaella would one day stand beside Visenor as queen.

reyenald-reyne.overview: Met the young swordsman after interrupting his practice with Lord Commander Orwell Morrigen; Reyenald immediately knelt and introduced himself.
reyenald-reyne.latestDevelopment: Met the young swordsman after interrupting his practice with Lord Commander Orwell Morrigen; Reyenald immediately knelt and introduced himself.

saera-targaryen.overview: Greets Saera's return from Winterfell with delight, immediately becoming fascinated by the white direwolf pup Saera carries and asking whether it is her present.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Greets Saera's return from Winterfell with delight, immediately becoming fascinated by the white direwolf pup Saera carries and asking whether it is her present.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Her eldest brother among the King's children.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His disappearance is one of the great absences in the family, though Vhaemys is too young to understand the politics that forced him away.

lucas-corbray.overview: Lucas remains her beloved protector and partner in mischief.
lucas-corbray.latestDevelopment: When Jace discovers he helped her avoid the spirit of a kitchen-cleaning punishment, Vhaemys defends him fiercely and promises they will not repeat it.

summary: Vhaemys overhears Baelenys and Jaery quarrelling over Vaenarr and, through a frightened child's reasoning, concludes that her mother never loved her father and that the royal family is turning against him. After a night of nightmares she becomes convinced that something is calling her into the storm. She leads Saera, Jace and Cloudgazer to an enormous unidentified white dragon above King's Landing. The dragon fixes its attention on her and closes its eye as she commands it to obey, but the encounter does not yet confirm a claim or rider bond.

name: Visenor Targaryen
title: Crown Prince Visenor of House Targaryen

secret.note: At Highgarden under the identity of Maester Arthur Sand after traveling from Oldtown with Leo Tyrell, Clarisse Flowers and Martyn Mullendore. His identity remains concealed from the Crown. He does not know that Rhaella and their unborn child have died near Starfall. Boneskin's existence remains unknown to the Crown.

goals: Maintain the identity of Maester Arthur Sand in Oldtown
Keep House Hightower and House Tyrell from collapsing into a Reach civil war
Prevent House Gardener from winning King Baelenys' support
Complete the forged letter linking Lord Gardener to Vahaemon and the supposed discovery of Vhagar
Build support without becoming dependent on House Tyrell
Return home a king worth trusting
Deepen his bond with Boneskin
Maintain secret contact with Rhaella
Learn what happened to Rhaella and Boneskin near Starfall

alester-dayne.overview: The knight who saved his and Rhaella's lives twice over in the woods south of King's Landing, at tremendous personal cost.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Visenor embraced him as a friend before he left Starfall.

almar-larchmont.overview: Together in Oldtown they complete the false Vahaemon letter meant to incriminate Lord Gardener.
almar-larchmont.latestDevelopment: Almar then receives the Dorne report and quietly worries about Nymos while Visenor turns his attention back toward Starfall.

baelenys-targaryen.overview: Once the King's most trusted child.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: That trust has now been shattered, along with two of his teeth.

baelor-targaryen.overview: He has come to know Baelor partly through the old maester's research rather than through direct companionship. Letters and notes on dragons, dreamers, and Vahaemon reached Visenor in exile and quietly shaped the questions he began asking about his family.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: In the Citadel he uses Baelor's explicitly uncertain Vhagar research to make forged evidence credible to its intended reader, without proving that Vhagar has actually been found.

boneskin.overview: A lean, pale-scaled dragon of extraordinary intelligence that had been roosting in the Red Mountains near Starfall.
boneskin.latestDevelopment: After days of patience, shared meals, and Valyrian songs, Visenor earned its trust and eventually rode it.

clarisse-flowers.overview: A Hightower bastard and formidable swordswoman whom Melessa personally assigned as Visenor's protector. Visenor initially questioned the unexpected choice, only for Clarisse to decisively defeat him in their first private spar.
clarisse-flowers.latestDevelopment: He accepted the lesson readily and told her there was much he could learn from her.

edmyn-uller.overview: The blunt Dornish maester who tended to him and Rhaella at the scholars' retreat and briefed him on events in the realm with startling frankness.
edmyn-uller.latestDevelopment: Visenor found his honesty unexpectedly refreshing.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Often disagrees with his methods, though it was Gaelor who first argued Visenor should never split his clutch of dragons among the family.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Often disagrees with his methods, though it was Gaelor who first argued Visenor should never split his clutch of dragons among the family.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: His opinion of Jace changed completely after learning of his secret help and the price Ser Alester nearly paid for it.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His opinion of Jace changed completely after learning of his secret help and the price Ser Alester nearly paid for it.

jaery-targaryen.overview: His mother, who is desperate for news of him and has openly wept over his disappearance.
jaery-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His mother, who is desperate for news of him and has openly wept over his disappearance.

leo-tyrell.overview: Leo travels with Visenor to Oldtown but no longer trusts the alliance around him.
leo-tyrell.latestDevelopment: While Visenor and Almar are distracted by a raven, Leo slips into Almar's private chambers and begins searching his papers.

lorenah-dayne.overview: Granted him and Rhaella sanctuary despite the danger it posed to her own house.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: Visenor has promised to repay her hospitality when he is able.

maela-targaryen.overview: His sister now carries Jadefyre, the one hatchling of his own clutch to survive.
maela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His sister now carries Jadefyre, the one hatchling of his own clutch to survive.

martyn-mullendore.overview: The Reach knight who recognised Visenor beneath his disguise during the Oldtown street ambush and chose to protect rather than expose him.
martyn-mullendore.latestDevelopment: Martyn brought him to Melessa Hightower, accompanied him to Highgarden, and remains among the small circle who know Arthur Sand is actually the Crown Prince.

melessa-hightower.overview: The young Lady of Oldtown whose household now shelters him beneath the identity of Maester Arthur Sand. Visenor agreed to serve as her tutor in repayment of the debt his family owes House Hightower.
melessa-hightower.latestDevelopment: Melessa is one of the few people in Oldtown trusted with his true identity.

renrose-tyrell.overview: Lord of Highgarden and Visenor's most powerful political ally in the Reach. At the Mander's Pact, Renrose pledged the strength of House Tyrell to Visenor's claim in exchange for the Handship under his future reign and a marriage alliance between their children. Visenor accepted but remains wary of becoming dependent upon Tyrell power. At their latest breakfast he entrusts Renrose with the Gardener scheme and calls him his future Hand.
renrose-tyrell.latestDevelopment: He does not hear Renrose's later repudiation of loyalty to him.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: A report of burned men and a dragon near Starfall immediately makes him fear that Boneskin has escaped and that Rhaella may be involved.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He begins thinking about returning south, still unaware that she and their unborn child are dead.

saera-targaryen.overview: One of the siblings he trusts most.
saera-targaryen.latestDevelopment: One of the siblings he trusts most.

vahaemon-targaryen.overview: His exiled uncle and a threat to the Crown whose name Visenor is now prepared to weaponize.
vahaemon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Visenor has proposed forging evidence of a secret Vahaemon-Gardener pact in order to turn Baelenys against Lord Gardener.

vhaemys-targaryen.overview: His youngest sister, still a child when he vanished from King's Landing.
vhaemys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He has always regarded her with the protective affection of an elder brother, though his exile has left them separated.

liana-tyrell.overview: Renrose introduces Liana as his wife and confidante while she listens to their Highgarden conversation.
liana-tyrell.latestDevelopment: Visenor does not witness her later warning to Renrose.

renrose-tyrell-daughter.overview: Notices Renrose's daughter watching him at Highgarden and wonders whether she knows who he really is.
renrose-tyrell-daughter.latestDevelopment: Notices Renrose's daughter watching him at Highgarden and wonders whether she knows who he really is.

summary: Visenor notices Leo's unease after Highgarden but accepts the boy's promise to speak when he understands his feelings. In the Proud Lantern they acknowledge how their fathers shaped them and how much their relationship has exceeded a simple arrangement between mentor and pupil. Visenor tells Leo about the reported dragon in Dorne, and they agree in principle to investigate it together. They have not yet left Oldtown, and Visenor remains unaware that Rhaella and their unborn child are dead.

name: Weylar Rocke
title: Master of Whisperers to the Hand of the King
goals: Remain indispensable to Jace
Expand his network of informants throughout King's Landing
Never again see the inside of the black cells
Find a suitable tutor for Princess Vhaemys before the King's influence becomes permanent

daria-sand.overview: Lorenah Dayne's maid and spy, who has been watching his increasingly conspicuous drunken behavior in Flea Bottom.
daria-sand.latestDevelopment: Lorenah instructed Daria to speak with him and make him stop drawing attention.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Jace gives Weylar a new secret assignment after the Starfall report: use his own contacts to investigate Rhaella and Nymos's disappearance, with the black cells waiting if the matter leaks.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Jace gives Weylar a new secret assignment after the Starfall report: use his own contacts to investigate Rhaella and Nymos's disappearance, with the black cells waiting if the matter leaks.

summary: Jace's personal spymaster, and proof that terror makes for sturdier loyalty than trust ever could. Weylar once fed the Prince a hollow report and spent time in the black cells for it; the pardon bought Jace an informant who now bows low enough to scrape the floor. His network has paid off repeatedly: first bringing word of Gaelor's brothel visit days after the wedding, then relaying early confirmation of the Oldtown Massacre. He has since been tasked with finding a tutor for young Vhaemys, a task he approaches with the same mixture of eagerness and dread that characterizes everything he does for the Hand.

name: Edmyn Uller
title: Maester of the Scholars' Retreat

secret.note: Killed near Starfall on the Eighth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, at the hands of the men sent by Renrose Tyrell.

goals: Tend to Rhaella at the scholars' retreat
Keep the hidden princess safe and informed
Recognize and decipher any covert message Visenor sends from beyond Dorne

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: He has never served Jace directly, but his blunt reports from the scholars' retreat proved useful to the Hand.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Through ravens and the fugitives in Dorne, Edmyn has become an unlikely source of information for a prince he barely knows.

lorenah-dayne.overview: Dispatched by Lady Dayne to the scholars' retreat to attend the fugitive prince and princess.
lorenah-dayne.latestDevelopment: Dispatched by Lady Dayne to the scholars' retreat to attend the fugitive prince and princess.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: Confirmed her pregnancy and attended her in hiding.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He is missing by the fourteenth day of the eighth moon, when Rhaella repeatedly asks for news of him.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Previously tended to Visenor at the scholars' retreat.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Visenor has now sent a coded raven toward Rhaella using a Dornish cipher specifically in the hope that Edmyn will be able to break it.

nymos.overview: A younger maester attends Rhaella during Edmyn's unexplained absence.
nymos.latestDevelopment: Their personal relationship and any direct exchange remain unshown.

summary: A Dornish maester dispatched by Lady Lorenah Dayne to attend Prince Visenor and Princess Rhaella at the scholars' retreat near Starfall. Unimpressed by titles and unusually direct in his delivery, he was the one who confirmed Rhaella's pregnancy and the one who briefed Visenor on the state of the realm — including the massacres, embargoes, and political collapses — with a vocabulary and frankness that made the Crown Prince laugh for the first time in weeks. His Dornish accent is heavy and his tongue is foul, which Visenor described privately as the most honest thing he had encountered since leaving King's Landing. By the fourteenth day of the eighth moon, he has been absent for days and Rhaella is increasingly alarmed. Nymos has no news of him. The unidentified body on the Dornish coast is not confirmed to be Edmyn.

name: Melessa Hightower
title: Lady of Oldtown
goals: Preserve House Hightower after the destruction of her family
Keep Visenor's identity hidden while he remains in Oldtown
Navigate the growing rivalry between the Tyrells and their challengers in the Reach
Keep Oldtown from becoming the battlefield of another great house

baelor-targaryen.overview: Sent the Grand Maester a conciliatory invitation to return to the Citadel, though the unusually political wording made Baelor suspect that another authority had shaped the message.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Sent the Grand Maester a conciliatory invitation to return to the Citadel, though the unusually political wording made Baelor suspect that another authority had shaped the message.

almar-larchmont.overview: The Hightower's maester and one of Melessa's most trusted protectors and advisers.
almar-larchmont.latestDevelopment: Almar guards both her safety and her discretion, including correcting her whenever she comes dangerously close to exposing Visenor's identity.

alysanne-hightower.overview: Her sister, killed in the same chaos that Melessa herself survived.
alysanne-hightower.latestDevelopment: Her sister, killed in the same chaos that Melessa herself survived.

clarisse-flowers.overview: A Hightower bastard whom Melessa values deeply and trusts enough to place personally at Visenor's side.
clarisse-flowers.latestDevelopment: She considers Clarisse the finest protection Oldtown can offer the hidden prince when he must leave the safety of the Hightower.

derrin-hightower.overview: Her father, whose treason helped set in motion the catastrophe that destroyed much of their family.
derrin-hightower.latestDevelopment: Her father, whose treason helped set in motion the catastrophe that destroyed much of their family.

leo-tyrell.overview: The young heir to Highgarden, sent by Renrose Tyrell to Oldtown ostensibly to receive an education alongside her.
leo-tyrell.latestDevelopment: His presence also places a Tyrell representative directly within her household.

martyn-mullendore.overview: The knight who brought the disguised Visenor to her after recognising him during the Oldtown street ambush.
martyn-mullendore.latestDevelopment: His decision placed him inside the small circle protecting the prince's secret.

renrose-tyrell.overview: The Lord of Highgarden whose influence now reaches directly into her household through his son Leo.
renrose-tyrell.latestDevelopment: The weakened Hightowers remain politically closer to the Tyrells than to their rivals, although the imbalance in power makes that friendship difficult to separate from dependence.

timos-hightower.overview: Her brother, killed during the royal assault on Oldtown.
timos-hightower.latestDevelopment: Her brother, killed during the royal assault on Oldtown.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Shelters the missing Crown Prince inside the Hightower under the identity of Maester Arthur Sand. Visenor has entered her household publicly as a tutor, while Melessa is among the handful who know who he truly is.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Their arrangement carries both personal and political weight, with Visenor regarding his service partly as repayment for what House Targaryen inflicted upon hers.

summary: Lady Melessa continues sheltering Visenor in Oldtown while trying to keep her weakened house out of another Reach war. She joins Visenor and Almar as a raven from Dorne reports burned men and a possible dragon near Starfall. The conversation reveals nothing of Visenor's private fear, and Melessa remains unaware that the news may concern Boneskin and Rhaella directly.

name: Visenya Targaryen
title: Princess Visenya of House Targaryen

secret.note: Alive and back in Essos beside Vahaemon after her appearance in King's Landing. Crown intelligence strongly suspects she has a dragon; this remains secret information.

goals: Determine who she will need to kill when the family's war in Essos begins
Demonstrate to the Red Keep that Vahaemon has friends inside its walls
Retrieve or protect Dark Sister
Return to wherever she came from without being caught

alester-dayne.overview: She escaped him after he smashed into Jace's chamber and tried to seize her.
alester-dayne.latestDevelopment: Visenya slipped Alester's grip, flashed a concealed dagger close enough to cut his tunic, and vanished into King's Landing before the Kingsguard could recover.

baelor-targaryen.overview: She is remembered by Baelor from childhood, though what she thinks of her scholarly great-uncle now is unknown.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: His attempt to understand her motives places him among the few people at court treating her as more than a blade-shaped threat.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Mistook him for Gaelor in a Flea Bottom brothel; held Dark Sister to his throat throughout the encounter and left before he or Alester could detain her.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Their conversation suggested she is watching the Essos campaign closely.

naela-targaryen.overview: Her mother, Princess Naela Targaryen, whose current location and condition remain unknown.
naela-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her mother, Princess Naela Targaryen, whose current location and condition remain unknown.

rhaella-targaryen.overview: Her sister, whose current location and condition she presumably does not know.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her sister, whose current location and condition she presumably does not know.

vahaemon-targaryen.overview: She is revealed back at her father's side in Essos.
vahaemon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: The Crown now suspects her earlier appearance in King's Landing was connected to Vahaemon's wider preparations.

aegor-targaryen.overview: Her brother Aegor is revealed beside the same Essosi circle, already bonded to Sunfyre and known as the Young Dragon.
aegor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her brother Aegor is revealed beside the same Essosi circle, already bonded to Sunfyre and known as the Young Dragon.

summary: After infiltrating King's Landing with Dark Sister and disappearing again, Visenya is revealed alive in Essos beside her father Vahaemon and uncle Vaenarr. The Crown's Master of Whisperers believes she likely has a dragon of her own, though its identity is unknown. Her brief visit to the capital now appears to have been one move inside a much larger preparation involving blood magic, Tyroshi support and several dragons gathered around Vahaemon.

name: Naela Targaryen
title: Princess Naela of House Targaryen

secret.note: No information about Naela's current whereabouts or condition is known to the realm.

goals: Unknown

rhaella-targaryen.overview: Her daughter, currently in hiding in Dorne.
rhaella-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her daughter, currently in hiding in Dorne.

vahaemon-targaryen.overview: Her husband; she is believed to remain in exile alongside him, though her present condition and exact whereabouts are uncertain.
vahaemon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her husband; she is believed to remain in exile alongside him, though her present condition and exact whereabouts are uncertain.

visenya-targaryen.overview: Her daughter, whose current location even Rhaella does not know.
visenya-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Her daughter, whose current location even Rhaella does not know.

summary: Naela Targaryen, wife of the exiled Vahaemon, is physically present with his circle across the Narrow Sea. She suffers from an unexplained recurring illness and undertakes dangerous journeys, usually north of Tyrosh, after which she returns stronger and healthier. Denlon suspects that the treatment may be entangled with blood magic, but this remains an intelligence assessment rather than confirmed fact.

name: Godfrey Blackwood
title: Lord Godfrey Blackwood of Raventree Hall
traits: Openly Unconventional in His Personal Tastes
goals: Build goodwill with the new Hand of the King
Perform creditably in the tourney lists
Enjoy himself without apology
Secure Crown justice for his cousin's death at Bracken hands

clarisse-flowers.overview: He once crossed swords with Clarisse while she was disguised as a man in a tournament.
clarisse-flowers.latestDevelopment: If her account is to be believed, she left the famed Blackwood warrior with injuries that took him a long time to forget.

clover-tully.overview: He no longer trusts Clover to arbitrate the feud with House Bracken.
clover-tully.latestDevelopment: After Clover dismissed his cousin's killing as a drunken mistake and refused to mobilize against Stone Hedge, Godfrey bypassed his liege and appealed directly to the Crown.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Tackled Ser Brant Costayne into the mud when Costayne drove a sword through Gaelor's horse's chest and attempted to murder the prince — an intervention that likely saved Gaelor's life and has not yet been formally acknowledged.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Tackled Ser Brant Costayne into the mud when Costayne drove a sword through Gaelor's horse's chest and attempted to murder the prince — an intervention that likely saved Gaelor's life and has not yet been formally acknowledged.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Complimented his tenure as Hand before the tourney and faced him in the quarter-finals in a hard six-pass tilt; was unhorsed cleanly and congratulated Jace from the dirt. Alester reported seeing him descend from an inn's upper rooms flanked by a serving wench and a stableboy, and noted that he makes no secret of his tastes. Brought the Bracken border killing before the Hand's throne; was offered two paths — a Crown envoy or a trial by combat — and accepted both as grounds to wait.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Also threatened to ride North to Stark if the Crown failed him, a gambit Jace noted without flinching.

perric-bracken.overview: He holds Perric responsible for the border killing of his cousin, rejecting the Bracken claim that it was merely a drunken accident.
perric-bracken.latestDevelopment: The dispute has become personal enough that Godfrey bypassed Lord Tully and carried his demand for justice to the Crown.

summary: A well-traveled lord from the Riverlands who arrived at the tourney with kind words for the Hand and a six-pass joust that lasted long enough to impress the stands before Jace's final lance throw sent him into the dirt. He congratulated Jace graciously, which cost him nothing; he then saved Gaelor Targaryen's life by tackling Brant Costayne mid-assassination, which cost him rather more. He makes no secret of his broader appetites, a fact Ser Alester noted with mild amusement from a roadside inn and relayed to Jace with more detail than was strictly necessary.

name: Lorent Tyrell
title: Former Lord of Highgarden and Warden of the South
goals: Remove King Baelenys from power before another war could bleed the realm

baelenys-targaryen.overview: The king he conspired to poison, believing Baelenys's appetite for war would bleed the realm dry.
baelenys-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Summoned from Highgarden to King's Landing, Lorent was condemned and executed by Baelenys's order.

derrin-hightower.overview: His co-conspirator in the plot to poison King Baelenys.
derrin-hightower.latestDevelopment: Lorent first approached Derrin with the plan, believing the realm could not endure another of the King's wars.

renrose-tyrell.overview: His son and successor, twenty-five years his junior, who inherited Highgarden and the wardenship of the South after Lorent's execution.
renrose-tyrell.latestDevelopment: His son and successor, twenty-five years his junior, who inherited Highgarden and the wardenship of the South after Lorent's execution.

summary: Lorent Tyrell was Lord of Highgarden and Warden of the South before his son Renrose. Convinced that the realm could not survive another of King Baelenys's wars, he drew Derrin Hightower into the conspiracy to poison the King. When the plot began to unravel, Lorent obeyed a royal summons and rode from Highgarden to King's Landing. On the Fifth Day of the Third Moon, five days after Derrin's secret death, Baelenys condemned Lorent for treason and ordered his execution in the capital. Renrose inherited Highgarden two moons before the Oldtown Massacre.

name: Renrose Tyrell
title: Lord of Highgarden and Warden of the South
goals: Secure the position of Hand of the King under Visenor's future reign
Cement the Tyrell-Targaryen alliance through a marriage between their children
Maintain eyes on Visenor's movements through Leo's presence in Oldtown
Seize House Gardener's lands as soon as the Crown brands its lord a traitor
Raise House Tyrell above every rival, including Visenor Targaryen

almar-larchmont.overview: He regards Almar as part of the machinery keeping Oldtown stable and Melessa protected.
almar-larchmont.latestDevelopment: Almar, however, watches Renrose's influence over the weakened Hightowers carefully and is wary of how easily assistance can become control.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: He considers Gaelor the principal obstacle between Visenor and the throne and has privately argued that the prince must be removed for the sake of the realm and Oldtown's dead.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Renrose's hostility is political, strategic, and increasingly tied to succession.

leo-tyrell.overview: Dispatched his fourteen-year-old son to Oldtown under the guise of education alongside Melessa Hightower — in practice, a political foothold and a pair of eyes inside the Hightower.
leo-tyrell.latestDevelopment: Dispatched his fourteen-year-old son to Oldtown under the guise of education alongside Melessa Hightower — in practice, a political foothold and a pair of eyes inside the Hightower.

lorent-tyrell.overview: His father and predecessor, twenty-five years his senior.
lorent-tyrell.latestDevelopment: Renrose inherited Highgarden and the wardenship of the South after Lorent was executed for treason shortly after Derrin Hightower's death.

martyn-mullendore.overview: Relies on Mullendore as a trusted sword arm operating in Visenor's orbit; Martyn's loyalty to the prince rather than to Renrose directly is a variable he has not yet been forced to reckon with.
martyn-mullendore.latestDevelopment: Relies on Mullendore as a trusted sword arm operating in Visenor's orbit; Martyn's loyalty to the prince rather than to Renrose directly is a variable he has not yet been forced to reckon with.

melessa-hightower.overview: Sees her as a piece to be positioned rather than a person; inserting Leo into her household is partly about influence over the last Hightower heir.
melessa-hightower.latestDevelopment: Sees her as a piece to be positioned rather than a person; inserting Leo into her household is partly about influence over the last Hightower heir.

visenor-targaryen.overview: He welcomes Visenor's plan to frame Lord Gardener and agrees to seize the rival house's lands.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Although Visenor likes and trusts him, Renrose privately resolves that House Tyrell's ambition must ultimately rise above the prince as well.

liana-tyrell.latestDevelopment: He welcomes her knowledge of his dealings with Visenor, but rejects her warning against pursuing still greater power.

renrose-tyrell-daughter.overview: His unnamed daughter, present beside him at the breakfast welcoming Visenor to Highgarden.
renrose-tyrell-daughter.latestDevelopment: His unnamed daughter, present beside him at the breakfast welcoming Visenor to Highgarden.

summary: Lord Renrose Tyrell receives Visenor at Highgarden and embraces the plan to frame House Gardener as Vahaemon's secret ally. His role is to invade and secure Gardener lands the moment the Crown declares their lord a traitor. Yet after Visenor places the scheme in his hands, Lady Liana warns Renrose not to mistake the prince's trust for permission to demand more. Renrose rejects her restraint and privately resolves that the only worthy course is one that places House Tyrell above every other family—including Visenor's.

name: Ser Martyn Mullendore
title: Knight of the Reach
goals: Protect Visenor and ensure his survival in the Reach
Navigate the competing interests of Renrose Tyrell and the prince without openly defying either

leo-tyrell.overview: Rode alongside Leo on the journey from Highgarden to Oldtown; their dynamic is that of an experienced knight tolerating a haughty fourteen-year-old.
leo-tyrell.latestDevelopment: Rode alongside Leo on the journey from Highgarden to Oldtown; their dynamic is that of an experienced knight tolerating a haughty fourteen-year-old.

melessa-hightower.overview: Delivered Visenor to her in the hall where her brother was killed; their relationship is defined by that single fraught moment.
melessa-hightower.latestDevelopment: Delivered Visenor to her in the hall where her brother was killed; their relationship is defined by that single fraught moment.

renrose-tyrell.overview: Operates within Renrose's orbit but his demonstrated loyalty runs toward Visenor personally rather than to the Lord of Highgarden — a distinction that has not yet been tested openly.
renrose-tyrell.latestDevelopment: Operates within Renrose's orbit but his demonstrated loyalty runs toward Visenor personally rather than to the Lord of Highgarden — a distinction that has not yet been tested openly.

visenor-targaryen.overview: Recognised the disguised prince during the Oldtown street ambush and brought him to Melessa Hightower; has since ridden with him to Highgarden and now to Oldtown as part of his cover, making him one of the four people who know Visenor's true identity inside the Hightower.
visenor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Recognised the disguised prince during the Oldtown street ambush and brought him to Melessa Hightower; has since ridden with him to Highgarden and now to Oldtown as part of his cover, making him one of the four people who know Visenor's true identity inside the Hightower.

summary: Ser Martyn Mullendore is a knight of the Reach who stumbled into Visenor's orbit by chance and chose loyalty over convenience. He led the City Watch patrol that intervened in the Oldtown alley ambush, recognised the disguised prince, and delivered him to Lady Melessa rather than to the authorities — a decision that has since drawn him fully into the conspiracy. He now rides as part of Visenor's cover retinue in Oldtown, one of only four people inside the Hightower who know Maester Arthur Sand is a prince of the blood. In Chapter XVII, the party reaches Highgarden after several days on the road during which Visenor drills Leo in swordplay, footwork and endurance, with Clarisse and Martyn often joining the lessons.

name: Berholt Caswell
title: High Septon
goals: Deliver verdicts and guidance that he can honestly believe the gods would sanction
Preserve the Faith's independence without provoking a confrontation he cannot win
Act justly within the limits of what he believes is survivable — and wrestle privately with where that line sits

baelor-targaryen.overview: A tense, unequal antagonism. Baelor pushed hard; Berholt held his ground with a serenity that infuriated the Grand Maester, but he was also aware he was holding ground on a verdict rather than on the larger question — Gaelor's unpunished sin — where he had already failed to act.
baelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: After the massacre he raises the sept works Baelor repeatedly deferred and obtains a promise of assistance from Tion.

brant-costayne.overview: Saw in him a man who did what Berholt himself had not: acted on his convictions regardless of cost.
brant-costayne.latestDevelopment: That recognition, more than theology, drove him toward mercy.

gaelor-targaryen.overview: Never formally sanctioned him for Alysanne Hightower's murder — not from fear alone, but from a genuine uncertainty about whether an excommunication would serve the gods or simply detonate a crisis he could not contain.
gaelor-targaryen.latestDevelopment: He is not sure he made the right call, and that uncertainty coloured everything he said at the trial.

jacaelon-targaryen.overview: Agrees to lead rites and help calm Flea Bottom after Jace condemns Gaelor and Tion promises help for the sept's works.
jacaelon-targaryen.latestDevelopment: Their agreement serves both the grieving city and the Faith's standing.

tion-lannister.overview: Accepts Tion's promise of financial assistance and gives the Crown time to provide it.
tion-lannister.latestDevelopment: Accepts Tion's promise of financial assistance and gives the Crown time to provide it.

summary: High Septon Berholt Caswell is a man of genuine faith and genuine limits. After the Mummers' Blood, he answers Jace's request for the Faith to calm Flea Bottom by raising the sept works that Baelor had delayed. Berholt stops short of an ultimatum or Gaelor's excommunication; the Crown promises financial help, and he agrees to conduct rites for the dead and stand before the grieving city on the Crown's behalf.

name: Leo Tyrell
title: Heir to Highgarden
goals: Prove himself useful to his father's alliance with Visenor
Receive the education his father sent him to Oldtown for
Develop his skill with a sword
Earn the respect of Visenor and the older men around him

almar-larchmont.overview: Suspicious after hearing his father speak Almar's name, Leo secretly enters the maester's private chambers in Oldtown and searches his papers while Almar is distracted.
almar-larchmont.latestDevelopment: Suspicious after hearing his father speak Almar's name, Leo secretly enters the maester's private chambers in Oldtown and searches his papers while Almar is distracted.

martyn-mullendore.overview: Rode from Highgarden to Oldtown in his company.
martyn-mullendore.latestDevelopment: Martyn treats him with the patience of an experienced knight accustomed to the pride of a young lord.

melessa-hightower.overview: Sent to Oldtown to receive an education alongside the young Lady of Oldtown.

summary: Clarisse Flowers is a twenty-year-old bastard of Hightower blood, a short-haired, physically imposing swordswoman who was raised more like a son than a daughter and never prepared for the conventional life of a lady. Though neither a knight nor, by her own insistence, a lady, she has developed into an exceptional fighter and claims to have crossed swords with some of the realm's greatest knights while competing in disguise as a man. Among them was Lord Godfrey Blackwood, whom she says she left badly wounded. Lady Melessa Hightower values Clarisse highly and, on the Ninth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, assigned her to protect Visenor Targaryen throughout his concealed stay in Oldtown as Maester Arthur Sand. Visenor initially admitted surprise at being given a woman as his protector, prompting Clarisse to explain that she had never been raised as a conventional woman and could outfight many of the knights he had known at the Red Keep. When Visenor asked to test that claim, Clarisse proved it. After a hard spar that bloodied the prince's nose, she trapped him against a tree, evaded his counterattack, pinned his wooden sword beneath her boot and placed her own blade against his throat. Visenor accepted the defeat with good humor and told her there was clearly much he could learn from her. In Chapter XVII, the party reaches Highgarden after several days on the road during which Visenor drills Leo in swordplay, footwork and endurance, with Clarisse and Martyn often joining the lessons.

summary: An elderly, blind servant of Winterfell known to most as Old Nan, though she introduces herself as Mother Marya. She tends a small patch of rare flowers and possesses knowledge that does not sit comfortably within ordinary household service. When Ser Alester Dayne encountered her during his first visit to the North, Marya showed intimate knowledge of a fragile, metallic-petaled flower that grows only rarely in Winterfell and beyond the Wall, using it to offer him a cryptic warning about beauty and thorns. The following night she stood beside Rickard Stark and Princess Saera with a steaming herbal drink; when Marya blew its vapor into Saera's face, the princess's clouded eyes cleared for several seconds and she saw perfectly for the first time in years. Whatever Marya truly knows, neither Alester nor Saera yet understands it.

summary: Edwyle Stark was Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North, father of Brandon Stark and grandfather of Rickard and Benjen Stark. Born in 28 AC, he belonged to the same broad political generation as King Aenys Targaryen II and became a significant ally of the Crown during Aenys' reign. Edwyle aided the King in ways that Baelenys still considered important many years later, though the precise nature of those services remains unknown. He died in 87 AC at the age of fifty-nine, after which Winterfell and the wardenship passed to his son Brandon. More than a decade after Edwyle's death, Baelenys openly admitted that although he had never cared much for Brandon personally, what Edwyle had done for Aenys still mattered enough for the Crown to honor the Stark family upon Brandon's death.

Lorenah treated the intelligence seriously but without panic and ordered Daria to deal with Weylar's public foolishness. Jacaelon later asks her to watch Vhaemys and ensure that she attends her lessons.

summary: Zekar Alasyr was one of the two senior hands of the Motley Three, a celebrated troupe whose fame reached far beyond Flea Bottom. Natural charisma, an ever-mocking expression and a dangerous comic edge let him seize an audience with a glance. Alongside Merryn Whitespring he trained the younger Mydan Gerren in acting, improvisation, vocal and physical mimicry, crowd work and the judgment needed to test the limits of satire. By the troupe's final performance Mydan stood beside them as an equal. Their returns to Flea Bottom were acts of loyalty to the neighborhood and stages that made them, not signs of obscurity. That reputation made Gaelor's attack upon their royal farce a cultural and political outrage as well as a massacre.

summary: Merryn Whitespring was a relaxed, cunning and flamboyant master of the stage, one of the older two members of the Motley Three. He and Zekar Alasyr raised Mydan Gerren from pupil to peer, teaching him the full craft of performance and the perilous art of judging an audience. The three became renowned across the realm for crude farce, razor-edged satire and merciless impersonations of nobles and royals. They still returned to small Flea Bottom stages out of allegiance to the place where they began, despite possessing fame, technical mastery and social influence far beyond the district. Merryn was killed during Gaelor's assault on the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC; the attack therefore struck at a recognized cultural institution, not an anonymous band of street fools.
